page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Aberrant spectres are Slayer monsters that require level 60 Slayer to kill, and completion of Priest in Peril to receive as a Slayer task . They frequently drop large numbers of grimy herbs and herb seeds . Because of this, bringing a herb sack and seed box when killing them is recommended.
Deviant spectres , found in the Catacombs of Kourend , can be killed in their place if you are assigned aberrant spectres.

Wearing a nose peg or Slayer helmet is required when fighting aberrant spectres; otherwise they will use a special attack which will always hit, even through Protection Prayers , and drain your combat stats extremely quickly, in addition to other stats. Boosts cannot be used to equip a nose peg, so either level 60 Slayer or a Slayer helmet is required.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The abhorrent spectre is a superior variant of the aberrant spectre . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master . Like their standard variant, a nose peg or Slayer helmet is required to safely engage them, as otherwise the player will take rapid damage and have their stats drained.

In addition to 100% drops and tertiary drops, superior slayer monsters will always roll 3 additional items, of which only 1 roll may be from the superior unique table. The other rolls are performed on the regular counterpart's table; their displayed drop chances represent a single roll.
Drop rates are estimated based on 820,736 samples from the Drop Rate Project , unless otherwise cited.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Abyssal demons are one of the strongest types of demons , requiring level 85 Slayer to be damaged. Alongside their boss variant , they are the only creatures in the game to drop the abyssal whip and abyssal dagger . They have relatively high accuracy but their max hit of 8 is low for their combat level.

In combat, abyssal demons are capable of teleporting either themselves or the player around, meaning that safespotting is not viable. When landing a successful hit on an abyssal demon, it has a 1/6 chance to teleport away, followed by a 1/3 chance to teleport the player away in case the first roll fails. [ 1 ] Abyssal demons can teleport players up to 20 tiles away. [ 2 ] When teleported, you will stop attacking the demon. Having Auto Retaliate turned on can help make sure you fight back. The forced teleport on the player can be avoided by reading a Teleport anchoring scroll .
Killing an abyssal demon in the Slayer Tower is a requirement for the Morytania elite diary .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: An Abyssal guardian is a monster that dwells in the Abyss , and also in the Abyssal Area ( fairy ring code A L R ). Abyssal guardians have fairly high Strength for their combat level , though they have low Attack and Defence levels.

Abyssal guardians initiate attack with melee , but use ranged if attacked first or the player is attacking them from a distance. Their ranged attacks are less accurate than their melee attacks, using their poor Ranged level for its accuracy, but can hit just as hard. However, as they have a very fast reaction time while aggressive , players usually see the ranged attack only after they become un-aggressive.
Drop rates are estimated based on 11,733 samples from the Drop Rate Project , unless otherwise cited.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: An abyssal leech is a monster that dwells in the Abyss , and also in the Abyssal Area . They are the easiest abyssal monsters to kill because they have low defence , low strength , and low hitpoints . However, they have a very high Attack level and attack speed, attacking every second tick , making them more dangerous than their combat level may suggest.
Drop rates are estimated based on 56,826 samples from the Drop Rate Project , unless otherwise cited.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The Abyssal walker is one of many monsters which can be found in the Abyss , and also in the Abyssal Area ( fairy ring code: A L R ). They are difficult to hunt as they seem to have a high defence , hitpoints , and strength , although they have low accuracy. It should also be noted that they are difficult to poison , although they are not immune to it. Abyssal walkers killed in the Abyss yield much lower experience . These monsters are aggressive , but will stop being aggressive after a while as well as the Abyssal guardian and the Abyssal leech .

If hunting Abyssal monsters for essence pouches , it is recommended to use magic against these, as despite their high magic defence, they have a very low magic level, enabling magic spells to hit accurately. Using multi-target spells like Ice Barrage in the southwestern corner of the Abyss makes this very fast. At relatively high Defence and Magic levels (70+) a player should have little to no trouble with them, even accounting for the aggressive monsters in the outer ring of the Abyss. Alternatively, a crush weapon or a weapon with a secondary crush style can be used effectively due to their low crush defence.
Drop rates are estimated based on 11,145 samples from the Drop Rate Project , unless otherwise cited.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Adamant dragons are metal dragons first encountered during Dragon Slayer II , in which the player must fight against one during Zorgoth 's assault. After completion of the quest, they can be found in the western chamber of the Lithkren Vault .

To get back to the laboratory underneath Lithkren , players can travel using the rowboat from the quest or, after completion, taking a digsite pendant and using it on the strange machine north of the rune dragon room, adding a teleport straight to Lithkren on it.

Adamant dragons are the result of a side project of Zorgoth 's after being inspired by another dragonkin , Forcae , which involves infusing dragon eggs with various metals. While Forcae's metal dragons were created to find a solution to the dragonkin's infertility, Zorgoth had bred his metal dragons for his war against humanity .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Albatrosses are monsters that can be found in the Sunset Ocean , Shrouded Ocean , Northern Ocean , and Unquiet Ocean . They may be assigned as a bounty task starting at 50 Sailing . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from The Summer Shore .
They are killed for their swift albatross feather drops, which is needed to build the gale catcher facility .
Boats require a dragon keel to not take any damage from them.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The Ancient Custodian is a superior variant of custodian stalkers . It has a chance of spawning upon the death of an elder Custodian stalker after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .
When an ancient Custodian spawns, a unique animation plays in which up to three other nearby Custodian stalkers will howl alongside it.

In addition to 100% drops and tertiary drops, superior slayer monsters will always roll 3 additional items, of which only 1 roll may be from the superior unique table. The other rolls are performed on the regular counterpart's table.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Ancient Wyverns are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 82 in order to be harmed. They reside in the Wyvern Cave on Fossil Island and are the strongest species of Wyvern in Old School RuneScape . Like with other Wyverns , an elemental shield , mind shield , dragonfire shield , dragonfire ward or ancient wyvern shield provides significant protection against their icy breath , and they are vulnerable to the effects of dragonbane weapons . These monsters require completion of the Bone Voyage quest to be assigned as a Slayer task.

In addition to being harder to fight, Ancient Wyverns share the ability with Taloned Wyverns and Long-tailed Wyverns to use a typeless ranged attack that resembles a lighter coloured Water Blast . This attack ignores Protection prayers and hits for up to 10 damage, though it can also miss. They also use a Slash melee attack. When fighting them, the highest defensive armour the player can access is best suited to use against them. Should one choose to use ranged to fight them, it is recommended to fight in melee range and use Protect from Melee after de-aggroing the Wyverns.
Aggression can be removed by setting up a tolerance zone and staying within it.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Ankou are skeletal, ghostly monsters. Ankou in the fourth level of the Stronghold of Security can drop the left skull half , one of four parts of the skull sceptre .

Ankou are popular monsters for their common death and blood rune drops, and in the Wilderness they are an excellent source of dark fishing bait . They can be assigned as Slayer tasks by Vannaka , Nieve / Steve , Krystilia , Duradel / Kuradal , and Konar quo Maten .

The salve amulet works on this monster as it is an undead creature. However, if ankou are your Slayer task, the salve amulet does not stack with the bonus received by the Slayer Helmet , and the former's bonus will take priority. It also does not work on secondary targets when using chinchompas or Ancient Magicks .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Aquanites are Slayer monsters found in the Ynysdail Cavern beneath Ynysdail . They require level 78 Slayer to fight, and Ynysdail requires level 73 Sailing to access. Aquanites can be assigned by Nieve and Duradel after purchasing the Lured In unlock for 80 Slayer reward points , or by Mortimer regardless if Lured In has been unlocked. There is also a task extension unlock available for 100 points.
Aquanites can drop the unique aquanite tendon , used to make the aquanite hopper . They have a very high drop rate for coral frags compared to other monsters.

If attacked with a weapon set to slash , their lure will be severed and their stab defence will be reduced by 50 (from 60 to 10), displaying the message Your attack cuts off the aquanite's lure! This attack does not need to deal damage to sever the lure. This only happens when the attack option is set to slash; it is not sufficient to only use a special attack like the Dragon dagger 's, which rolls against Slash defence .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Araxytes are a venomous species of arachnid with seven eyes found exclusively in the Morytania Spider Cave , requiring level 92 Slayer to kill. As they are abundant in numbers, able to inflict venom , and in a multicombat area , it is dangerous to fight them without prayer and a method to stave off venom.

There are two forms of araxytes; a level 96 version which is 1x1, and a level 146 version which is 2x2 and has slightly higher stats. They are killed for their aranea boots drop, a hybrid set of boots versatile when using multiple combat styles in one setup.

While both variants share the same drop table, the level 146 variants can be preferable to kill over the level 96 variants; their common drops are doubled, and the drop rate of the aranea boots are additionally doubled. They are also capable of spawning the Dreadborn Araxyte , something that the level 96 variants are incapable of doing. [ 1 ] However, players may still choose to kill the level 96 variant, as their lower HP makes them one of the fastest slayer tasks.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Armoured kraken are powerful sea krakens that are found in the Northern Ocean and Western Ocean . As their name suggests, they have significantly more defence against non-magic attacks than other krakens, due to a higher Defence level and double ranged defence bonuses. As such, cannons are not recommended, and instead magic, especially earth magic, is the preferred way to kill them.

They are killed for their dragon keel parts , large dragon keel parts , dragon metal sheets , inky paint , and bottled storm drops. Notably they drop the bottled storm without needing to unlock the eternal brazier like Vampyre Krakens .

The player may be assigned to kill them as a bounty task starting at 75 Sailing . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from Prifddinas . Players with two active armoured kraken bounty tasks will only receive tentacles until the task is completed at which point ink sacs will begin to drop.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Armoured zombies are level 82 undead found in Zemouregal's Base during the quest Defender of Varrock . They are notable for their unique drop, the broken zombie axe . As they reside in a multicombat area and spawn in close proximity to each other, they can be attacked with multi-hitting weapons such as burst spells and the venator bow as an effective training method. After defeating armoured zombies, a red mist will linger around and the message A strange red mist rises from the dying zombie. will be displayed. Besides bottling it during the Defender of Varrock quest, it has no uses or effects and presents no harm to the player.

Being an undead creature, all variants of the Salve amulet will have their undead bonus apply when attacking armoured zombies. However, when using multicombat styles, the effect only applies to the targeted zombie.

The number of Armoured zombies significantly increases after completion of the quest Defender of Varrock . The zombie axe is still obtainable from the armoured zombies during the quest, so full completion of Defender of Varrock is not required.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Armoured zombies can be found in the tunnels west of the basement in Zemouregal's Fort , who appear after the completion of The Curse of Arrav . They have slightly higher stats than the regular armoured zombies found in Zemouregal's Base , with their drop table being slightly more generous; notably, they exclusively drop the broken zombie helmet while also dropping the broken zombie axe at a higher rate than the zombies in Zemouregal's Base.

As undead , they are weak to the effects of both the salve amulet and the Crumble Undead spell. They similarly also reside in a multicombat area and spawn in close proximity to each other, and can thus be killed particularly effectively with multi-hitting weapons such as burst spells and the venator bow . However, players cannot set up a dwarf multicannon .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Baby blue dragons are the young of adult blue dragons found in Taverley Dungeon , the Isle of Souls Dungeon , the bottom floor of the Ruins of Tapoyauik , and in the basement of the Myths' Guild . Unlike their adult forms, they do not breathe fire.

Players who wish to kill baby blue dragons without being attacked by the adult blue dragons can find some in the Taverley Dungeon near the lava eel fishing spot, south of the Agility shortcut . They can also be killed on the east side of the main Taverley Dungeon room as no adult blue dragon will walk there.
They can be killed as an alternative for a blue dragon Slayer task .

He is one of K'ril Tsutsaroth 's bodyguards, along with Zakl'n Gritch and Tstanon Karlak . He attacks with Magic by launching huge fireballs at the player and has a maximum hit of 16.
Balfrug Kreeyath is considered a black demon for the purpose of a Slayer task . As with most demons, he is susceptible to the effects of demonbane weapons .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Banshees are a Slayer monster that require level 15 Slayer to kill. They can be found at the Slayer Tower in Morytania on the ground floor [ UK ] 1 st floor [ US ] , on the eastern side. Players must wear earmuffs or a Slayer helmet while fighting them in order to avoid the effects of their screams, which causes the player to take 6 damage and have their stats greatly reduced in Attack , Strength , Defence , Ranged , Magic , Prayer , and Agility with every attack received. There is a safespot to the north of the staircase leading to the 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] , behind the standing torch, between the staircase and wall. As banshee's attacks are magic-based , it is advised to wear ranged armour in order to minimise damage taken while fighting them. As banshees qualify as undead, the effects of the Salve amulets and the Crumble Undead spell will work on them (note, however, that the Salve amulet and Slayer helmet effects do not stack).
Much like cave crawlers , banshees regenerate their health back quickly, gaining back 1 hitpoint every 5 ticks.

While on a banshee Slayer task, there is a 1/200 chance that a Screaming Banshee will spawn after you kill a standard banshee (if you have Bigger and Badder unlocked). After claiming the elite tier rewards from the Combat Achievements system, this chance is increased to 1/150.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: A basilisk is a Slayer monster that requires a Slayer level of 40 to kill. Like cockatrice , players must equip a mirror shield or V's shield when fighting these monsters. Players require a Defence level of 20 in order to receive basilisks as a Slayer task , as this is required to wield the shield. To get a basilisk task from Duradel , Nieve , or Konar , players must have also purchased the "Basilocked" slayer reward , costing 80 points. Basilisks have below-average accuracy for their level, but have high Defence. They are weak to crush attacks, so weapons such as the zombie axe and the dragon mace are unusually strong if using melee. The dragon mace is generally around the same damage per second as the dragon scimitar , while the zombie axe deals approximately 7% more damage per second than either.
Without the mirror shield, the player's combat stats will be greatly reduced with each hit. The Protect from Melee prayer can be used against the damage, but the stats will still be lowered.
Basilisks frequently drop nature runes , so it can be useful to bring a staff of fire or fire runes in order to use High Level Alchemy on their frequent metal armour and weapon drops.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Basilisk Knights are a Slayer creature that can be found in Jormungand's Prison beneath the Island of Stone , requiring level 60 Slayer and completion of The Fremennik Exiles to kill. Like cockatrice and basilisks , players must equip a mirror shield or V's shield when fighting these monsters or they will take heavy damage and their stats will be drained. Uniquely, the attack speed of Basilisk Knights will match the player's current attack speed if they are outside of melee range, but can only go as low as 4 ticks if the player is using a faster weapon, like throwing knives .

The basilisk knight has an improved drop table from regular basilisks, and can drop the basilisk jaw , which can be used to upgrade the Helm of Neitiznot to the Neitiznot faceguard . It should be noted that the basilisk jaw drops at an extremely low rate (1/5000) when not on a Basilisk Slayer task (purchased and unlocked via Slayer Rewards ). Killing Basilisk Knights while on task grants a drop rate five times higher (1/1000) than killing them regularly.

Players cannot use a dwarf multicannon on Basilisk Knights, as the only places players can place a cannon in Jormungand's Prison are those which contain dagannoth . Additionally, players cannot resurrect thralls in Jormungand's Prison.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The basilisk sentinel is a superior variant of the basilisk knight . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master . Like their standard variant, a mirror shield or V's shield is required to safely engage them, as otherwise the player will take rapid damage and have their stats drained.

Along with its magic and melee attacks, it has a special attack in which it shoots a slower, pale-red coloured orb at the tile the player is currently standing on; if players do not move, this will encase them in stone, preventing players from attacking for a few seconds and displaying the message You have been entombed in stone! . This can be avoided while the orb is in flight by moving one square away, or by spam-clicking away to break free, similar to the fight against The Jormungand . When clicking away to break free, the message You feel the stone break slightly as you try to move. will be displayed. It will take four attempts to break free before succeeding, with success indicated by the message You manage to escape from the stone! . Failing to break out in time will result in a large amount of damage being inflicted, accompanied by the message The stone around you violently explodes! . While the special attack is easily avoidable, it can immediately kill players with moderate Hitpoints if they don't move in time. The special attack seems to have a cooldown of ~30 seconds beginning with the first attack, and is not guaranteed to be used immediately off cooldown.

In addition to 100% drops and tertiary drops, superior slayer monsters will always roll 3 additional items, of which only 1 roll may be from the superior unique table. The other rolls are performed on the regular counterpart's table.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Black dragons are the most powerful adult chromatic dragons . As with all adult dragons, protection from dragonfire (such as an anti-dragon shield ) is recommended when fighting them, although like other common chromatic dragons, they only use dragonfire at melee range.

Black dragons are the only common chromatic dragons that drop the draconic visage . Notably, the stronger level 247 variant in the Wilderness Slayer Cave drops the draconic visage at a rate of 1/5,000, the most common out of any dragon tied with the King Black Dragon and Vorkath .

Baby black dragons , brutal black dragons , and the King Black Dragon may be killed in place of black dragons for a Slayer task ; however, the KBD does not count towards a black dragon task assigned by Krystilia . Likewise, lava dragons do not count towards a black dragon task, despite their black dragonhide drop.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Blood Reavers are a type of demon in the service of Zaros found in the Ancient Prison within the God Wars Dungeon . They attack using a spell that resembles Blood Rush and can heal themselves a percentage of damage inflicted. Damaging a Blood Reaver heals the player for 50% of the damage dealt. This applies to Blood Reavers in both the Ancient Prison and in the Nex encounter.
During Nex 's blood phase, she will summon them to attack players. Their remaining hitpoints are transferred to Nex if they are not killed quick enough, which can be a problem for small teams.

As demons , bloodvelds are susceptible to demonbane weaponry .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Blue dragons are the third strongest of the chromatic dragons , behind red dragons and black dragons . Like all dragons, they can breathe dragonfire , which can inflict up to 50 damage if proper protections aren't used. Dragonfire can be mitigated by equipping an anti-dragon shield or a dragonfire shield – alongside the usage of an antifire potion , which will completely negate dragonfire damage. On top of the strong dragonfire breath, they also attack with an accurate slash attack.

Blue dragons are assignable as a Slayer task after starting Dragon Slayer I . Baby blue dragons also count toward blue dragon tasks, and can be found within the Myths' Guild , Isle of Souls , or the Taverley Dungeon . A variant of blue dragons are found in the Ruins of Tapoyauik that are uniquely weak to fire spells , instead of water like most chromatic dragons.
With a surprisingly fast respawn time of around 20 seconds, even areas with single spawns are suitable for training or collecting resources.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The Body Golem is one of the golems found in the Ruins of Camdozaal . It can be found by awakening the rubble lying in the section north-east of the bank chest. It is fueled by runic energies and imbued with the power of the nearby Body Altar . [ 1 ]

Only one golem may be awakened and fought at a time. Attempting to awaken another while one is already active will display the message You're already in combat with a golem. There's no time to awaken another. When you walk away from an awakened golem without killing it, it will disintegrate as if it died, without dropping any loot.
Body golems are notable for dropping the barronite guard , needed for construction of the barronite mace , and for dropping Body cores , used in Runecraft .

He also drops lyres which can be used in The Fremennik Trials , rather than having to make them with 25 Fletching . At level 45 Thieving and after The Fremennik Trials , he can be pickpocketed for 40 coins and 65 Thieving experience.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Brine rats are Slayer monsters that can be found in the Brine Rat Cavern near Rellekka . They are notable for being the only monsters to drop the brine sabre . A Slayer level of 47 is required to fight them.

They are only assigned to players who have completed Olaf's Quest . Additionally, they can be killed as an alternative for a rat Slayer task provided the player has the appropriate Slayer level to do so.
Killing a brine rat is a requirement for completing the medium task set in the Fremennik Diary .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Brutal blue dragons are a tougher version of blue dragons and can be killed as an alternative for a blue dragon Slayer task . They can be found in the Catacombs of Kourend and Ruins of Tapoyauik .

Players can access the dragons by running west through the Catacombs of Kourend or alternatively, use the hole found in Lovakengj to take them there immediately (unlocking this shortcut requires climbing up the vine from inside the catacombs first). They can also be found in the Ruins of Tapoyauik, easily accessed by using the Pendant of Ates after completion of The Heart of Darkness and activating the obelisk outside the ruins.

Like all brutal dragons , they use Melee , Magic and long-range dragonfire . Using both Protect from Magic and an antifire potion will completely protect players from their dragonfire and magic attacks, and they can be safespotted this way if not standing within melee range.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Catablepon are magical creatures that appear to be green bulls with reptilian tails. They are found on the third level of the Stronghold of Security . They drop the top of sceptre , one of four parts of the Skull sceptre .
They have a weakening glare [ 1 ] which drains your Strength , but will stop casting once 8% + 3 of your total strength level has been drained.

Players are not advised to train on these with Melee , as Weaken can drain Strength quite significantly, which will affect the player's experience rates in turn, unless Strength potions or Restore potions are used (you can also use the Protect from Magic prayer). They can use melee and magic attacks often and cast Weaken at the same time. After the spell has decreased 8% +3 of your Strength levels, catablepon will stop casting Weaken, but casts before this threshold can still bring you lower than the threshold. Ranged or Magic attacks are recommended instead of melee.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Cave crawlers are Slayer monsters that require level 10 Slayer to kill. A form of poison protection is recommended when killing them, as they inflict a strong poison with their barbed tongue. [ 1 ] They are the only enemy to drop bronze boots . They also drop a variety of Herblore ingredients, which can be helpful for lower level players looking for an alternative source of herbs over more popular sources, such as chaos druids . Lower level players should be aware that they have a rapid natural health regenerate rate, regenerating 1 hitpoint every 5 ticks.
If the Bigger and Badder Slayer reward has been unlocked, there is a chance that a Chasm Crawler will appear when killing cave crawlers on a Slayer task.
Drop rates are estimated based on 80,500 samples from the Drop Rate Project , unless otherwise cited.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Cave horrors are Slayer monsters and a type of horror found in the Mos Le'Harmless Cave . Killing them requires the completion of Cabin Fever , level 58 Slayer , a witchwood icon or protect from melee, and a light source (unless a fire of eternal light is lit). They are most often killed for their black mask drops along with a decent rate of hard clue scrolls .

The cave horrors have a special attack which always deals damage equal to 10% of the player's base Hitpoints level, rounded down (for example 9 damage at 96 Hitpoints). This attack can be partially avoided by wearing a witchwood icon, OR completely nullified by having Protect from Melee activated. This special attack also has a strange effect of being an Area-of-Effect (AoE) attack in a single-way combat area, hitting any players standing next to the cave horror not already in combat with it.

Using protection prayers allows players to use more powerful necklaces instead of the witchwood icon, as it only provides minor bonuses. Another strategy is to use safespots , but players should take caution leaving their safespot to loot, as the aggressive cave horrors may attack you. For this reason, if you do not have access to Protect from Melee, it is still recommended to bring the witchwood icon, or grab the loot using Telekinetic Grab .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Cave kraken are slayer monsters that are found in the Kraken Cove . They can only be attacked if players have them as a Slayer task . To be assigned cave krakens, players require level 87 Slayer and 50 Magic . Along with their boss variant, the Kraken , they are the only monsters to drop the kraken tentacle and the trident of the seas .

In order to fight a cave kraken, a player must first "disturb" one of the many whirlpools found within the cove. Fishing explosives cannot be used to surface the regular cave kraken like one might their boss counterpart.

Magic is the only reliable way of dealing damage to the cave kraken, as Ranged attacks deals 1/7th of its normal damage and Melee cannot be used, including halberds. Their attacks are magic rather than typeless (meaning they can be prayed against).

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Cave slimes are Slayer monsters that require level 17 Slayer to kill. They inflict poison regardless of whether they do damage or not, so it is advised that the player brings a form of poison protection when fighting them. If a player is next to a cave slime when they attack they may be poisoned even if the slime does not retaliate.

Cave slimes are found in two rooms of the Lumbridge Swamp Caves . A rope is needed if you have not entered the dungeon before. A light source is also required, but be aware that any exposed light sources (such as a candle ) may explode, dealing up to 25% of the current Hitpoints level in damage if you go into the northern spawning room. A good option for an enclosed light source is an bulleyes lantern . However , the entire southern room is risk free. For either room you will have to pass by a wall beast , so head protection ( spiny helmet / Slayer helmet ) can be helpful to avoid damage.
They have a guaranteed drop of roughly 3.5 swamp tar per kill, making them a decent low energy cost method for Ironmen to gather tar.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The Chaos Golem is one of the golems found in the Ruins of Camdozaal . It can be found by awakening the Rubble lying in the far south-east section of Camdozaal, south of the body golems . It is fueled by runic energies and corrupted by the unstable energies of the nearby Chaos Altar . [ 1 ]

Only one golem may be awakened and fought at a time. Attempting to awaken another while one is already active will display the message You're already in combat with a golem. There's no time to awaken another. When you walk far away from an awakened golem without killing it, it will disintegrate as if it died, without dropping any loot.
Chaos golems are notable for dropping the barronite guard , needed for construction of the barronite mace , and for dropping chaos cores , used in training Runecraft .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Chilled jellies are stronger variants of jellies that require level 52 Slayer to kill. They also require either completion of The Heart of Darkness or level 87 Sailing to reach, due to their locations: within the Ruins of Tapoyauik and inside the dungeon on Grimstone .

In most respects, they are identical to warped jellies . However, they have a 50% fire weakness and do not drop ancient shards and dark totem pieces (although if they are killed in the Ruins of Tapoyauik they will drop frozen tears and tooth halves of moon keys instead). Like all jellies , Chilled jellies have a chance to spawn their respective Vitreous Jelly on death, in this case a Vitreous Chilled Jelly , if the Bigger and Badder Slayer unlock is enabled.

Jellies attack with magical melee , so armour with high magic defence is recommended, such as Karil's armour or black dragonhide armour . Like their lower levelled counterparts, using Protect from Melee will prevent all damage from them.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Cockatrice are Slayer monsters that require level 25 Slayer to kill. A mirror shield or V's shield is highly recommended. Without one, the cockatrice will attack with its piercing gaze, which has a range of 5 tiles, hits for 11 damage, and rapidly drains combat stats. Otherwise, do not expect much of a fight from cockatrices. As 20 Defence is needed to wield a mirror shield, players who do not meet this requirement will not be assigned them as a task.
They are rarely killed outside of Slayer tasks, generally only by those hunting the rare mystic boots (light) and cockatrice head drops.

If necessary, players can utilise the large rock formation to the north of the cave to safespot cockatrice on the opposite side, even without a mirror shield, due to the limited range of piercing gaze. This is useful for pures who cannot wield a mirror shield, or for players who wish to use two-handed weapons like shortbows, but it is not generally recommended. While the damage of piercing gaze can be prevented by Protect from Melee , you still must bring a mirror shield or stand 6+ tiles away to avoid the stat drain.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The colossal hydra is a superior variant of the hydra . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master . Like their standard variant, they will alternate between ranged and magic every three attacks.

Instead of spitting poison, the colossal hydra has a special attack similar to the lightning special attack of the Alchemical Hydra , where it will shoot out a ball of electricity that splits into two lightning currents that chase after the player for some time, dealing moderate (up to ~18) damage and paralysing the player for 4 ticks (2.4s) if caught. It will use this special attack after every five standard attacks; as this does not line up with the timing of the attack style switch, caution should be taken when switching protection prayers .

In addition to 100% drops and tertiary drops, superior slayer monsters will always roll 3 additional items, of which only 1 roll may be from the superior unique table. The other rolls are performed on the regular counterpart's table; their displayed drop chances represent a single roll.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Cruor is one of the four mages guarding Nex in the Ancient Prison , within in the God Wars Dungeon . Having mastered blood magic , he enhances Nex's powers over blood. As with all of Nex's mages, he is immobile.
Cruor is invulnerable to damage until Nex reaches below 40% of her hitpoints. This is indicated by her shouting, Cruor, don't fail me!
He attacks using Blood Barrage and can heal himself a percentage of the damage inflicted.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: A cyclops (plural cyclopes ) is a large one-eyed giant . They are known for dropping many alchable drops, so bringing nature and fire runes is helpful as it allows players to make longer trips and more money without banking or taking up inventory space. The cyclopes found in the Warriors' Guild were brought over by Harrallak Menarous from the Wushanko Isles when he went on an expedition there.

Cyclopes in the Warriors' Guild have a rare chance of dropping a defender . These defensive weapons range from bronze to dragon and must be obtained in order, starting with bronze, by killing cyclopes on the top floor of the Warriors' Guild and then either re-entering the cyclops room with the defender in their inventory or by showing the defender to Kamfreena outside the chamber. Once a player earns the rune defender, they can enter the basement of the Warriors' Guild and kill the stronger cyclopes found there for a chance at the dragon defender. As this is located in the Warriors' Guild, cyclopes found in these areas are immune to Ranged and Magic attacks and must be fought with melee combat. As a result of being immune to Ranged damage, cyclopes are effectively immune to burn , which will be inflicted but reduced to 0 damage.
Cyclopes may be killed as a substitute for hill giants on a Slayer task .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Dagannoth are monsters that live in Waterbirth Island Dungeon .
The level 90 Dagannoth use an accurate melee attack, which hits often and hard against players. Protect from Melee, or Barrows armour or better, and food is recommended.

The level 88 Dagannoth use a fast and very accurate ranged attack which hits higher than their melee variants. They will stand still when aggressive and lose interest if the player leaves their attack range of 4, making them difficult to safespot. They are also known for dropping components to create spined armour , along with the spined gloves and spined boots .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Dark beasts are monsters that require level 90 Slayer to kill. They are found in the Mourner Tunnels under West Ardougne and in Iorwerth Dungeon in Prifddinas . Along with their superior variant , they are the only monster in the game to drop the dark bow and the death talisman .

Dark beasts attack with both Melee and Magic . However, they will only use Magic as their first attack if they are attacked by the player first, or if they cannot attack the player with Melee. Dark beasts do not follow tolerance rules and are always aggressive to the player regardless of how long they have stayed in their presence. Given their highly accurate melee attacks, Protect from Melee is recommended while killing dark beasts.

In addition to level 90 Slayer, a combat level of 90 is required to have them assigned to the player as a Slayer task , unless the player has spoken to a Slayer Master about the difficulty of assignments. The player also needs to have started Mourning's End Part II , however no progression is required; players who do not wish to be assigned them should not continue the dialogue after completing Mourning's End Part I .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Demonic gorillas are powerful creatures found in the Crash Site Cavern . Two of them are fought during Monkey Madness II , in the penultimate stage of the fight. After the quest is completed, more demonic gorillas can be found in the caverns alongside their tortured brethren. They are primarily killed for their zenyte shard and ballista component drops.

Demonic gorillas count as monkeys and black demons for the progression of Slayer tasks . As they are demons, they are susceptible to the effects of demonbane weapons , excluding holy water . Demonic gorillas cannot be damaged with a Dwarf multicannon .
Players can check their kill count by reading Nieve's gravestone next to Lumo at the opening in the fence.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Desert lizards are Slayer monsters found in the Kharidian Desert , requiring level 22 Slayer to kill. In order to kill a desert lizard, an ice cooler must be used when it has less than 5 Hitpoints . If an ice cooler is used on a desert lizard with 5 or more Hitpoints, the cooler will be consumed but have no effect. Players can buy the " Reptile freezer " perk from a Slayer Master for 10 Slayer points , which will automatically ice the desert lizard when it falls below 5 Hitpoints, provided that the player has an ice cooler in their inventory.

The lizards are located south-east of the Shantay Pass , across the River Elid , roaming around south of the area where orange salamanders can be caught. The easiest route to get there is by taking a magic carpet ride to the Ruins of Uzer , then heading south-west. Alternatively, players with access to fairy rings can use the code D L Q to get to them faster.

The lizards are found in areas affected by desert heat , so players are advised to bring a water source like waterskins to avoid taking damage from the heat. Those with access to the fairy ring system can easily refill waterskins by re-entering Zanaris and using the water fountain located north of the fairy ring. Alternatively, if you do not wish to carry waterskins, there are two Desert Lizards and two Small Lizards that spawn on the edge of Uzer Oasis, south-west of the tea shop. You will not lose health due to the desert heat when attacking these lizards.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Deviant spectres are stronger variants of aberrant spectres that require level 60 Slayer to kill, and completion of Priest in Peril to receive as a Slayer task . They are found exclusively within the Catacombs of Kourend .

Like aberrant spectres, a nose peg or Slayer helmet is required when fighting them; without either, their attacks will always hit and drain your combat stats extremely quickly. They are also aggressive to players in their vicinity, meaning that protective gear is highly recommended even if only passing by.
They have a high natural health regeneration, restoring 1 hitpoint every 5 ticks, so it is more efficient to kill a single deviant spectre at a time than to alternate between multiple targets.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The dire gryphon is the superior variant of the gryphon . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .
Dire gryphons are tougher than their ordinary counterparts, but have a similar drop table. Like their ordinary counterparts, they are cannonable.

Like normal gryphons, the dire gryphon is primarily weak to melee . A tortugan shield is highly recommended for the fight, otherwise the player will take heavy damage and receive the chat message: The gryphon's attacks are devastating! You need some sort of protection!

Any boat with an iron keel or better will not take any damage from dolphins.
Dolphin calves can often be seen following dolphins.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Drakes are wingless dragons found in the middle level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon in Mount Karuulm , requiring level 84 Slayer to kill. As they are only found within the volcano, players must wear the boots of stone , boots of brimstone , or granite boots to protect themselves from the extreme heat of the dungeon floor. Alternatively, players who have completed the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary have protection from the burn effect regardless of footwear.
Drakes are vulnerable to the effects of dragonbane weapons , which include the dragon hunter lance , dragon hunter crossbow , and dragon hunter wand .

Drakes were created as an experiment by a Dragonkin named Karuulm after his perceived failure of the wyrm project (to the disdain of Kerapac , who would rather focus only on the creation of dragons). Where wings would have grown, gaping sores are developed instead, causing constant pain to them. As a result, drakes are very aggressive.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The dreadborn araxyte is a superior variant of the araxyte , which can spawn after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master . Unlike other superior creatures, the dreadborn araxyte can only spawn if the level 146 araxytes are killed. [ 1 ]

The dreadborn araxyte has a special attack which starts by fully draining venom and poison resistance, then shooting a globule of dense venom at the player which can hit for up to 50 damage. The damage can be mitigated by reapplying venom immunity before the globule hits the player, which can be easily done via the araxyte venom sacs obtained as drops.

If the player does not have any venom or poison resistance, the araxyte will not use this attack; wearing a serpentine helm will prevent the attack from being used, though it will not prevent damage if the globule was launched, and does not prevent the globule from being launched if the player has venom resistance while wearing it. Similarly to nechryarchs ' chaotic death spawns , the attack is only used in melee distance, so safespotting the araxyte or binding it and staying out of melee distance will avoid this attack completely.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: A dust devil is a Slayer monster that requires level 65 Slayer to kill. They are located in the Smoke Dungeon , the Catacombs of Kourend , and the Wilderness Slayer Cave . A facemask (or a Slayer helmet / Slayer helmet (i) ) must be equipped to fight dust devils effectively. Without a facemask, dust devils will always hit for 16 damage, fully drain the player's Attack , Strength , Ranged , and Magic levels, and drain 50% of the player's Agility , Defence , and Prayer levels. With a facemask, dust devils attack with ranged-based melee , meaning that high range defensive bonuses or the Protect from Melee prayer are effective protection against their attacks.

Dust devils cannot be assigned as a Slayer task until Desert Treasure I has been started. [ 1 ] Dust devils in the Catacombs of Kourend and the Smoke Dungeon are popularly killed by bursting (or barraging ) and chinning while on-task.
Slaying a dust devil in the Smoke Dungeon with a Slayer helmet equipped is a requirement for the Hard Desert Diary .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Earthen nagua are Slayer monsters that require level 48 Slayer to kill. They are found in the Tonali Cavern after completion of the The Final Dawn quest. As with sulphur and frost nagua , earthen nagua have -4 flat armour , so all successful hits will do an extra 4 damage to them. Because of this, it is useful to bring a multi-hit weapon such as the glacial temotli , since each hit separately benefits from the flat armour.

When an earthen nagua is damaged after falling below 60% health, they enter a reinforced form, shifting their defences to be more resistant to slash while being weaker to crush . When they do so, a message in the chatbox states The nagua reinforces its outer body to protect itself. If a neutral damage type (such as poison or burn ) lowers their health to below 60%, this effect will only activate after they are attacked with regular damage. Entering their reinforced form also clears burns but does not prevent a new instance of burning.

Once an earthen nagua has entered its reinforced state, hitting it with a special attack while the weapon is set to crush causes their armour to shatter and become weakened, reducing all of their melee defence bonuses to 0, as well as restoring a small amount of prayer points. This mechanic cannot be triggered by the special attacks of the dual macuahuitl and Blue Moon spear , despite having crush combat styles.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Elder Chaos druids are high-level mages found at the Chaos Temple in the Wilderness . They are substantially stronger and more accurate than their lower-level counterparts , and are capable of teleblocking players and re-applying it consistently. Additionally, they can teleport fleeing players within melee distance, similar to abyssal demons . The teleportation spell has a maximum range of 20 tiles. [ 1 ] Having read a teleport anchoring scroll will prevent the druids from teleporting the player.
It is highly recommended to use Protect from Magic when killing the Elder Chaos druids, as they can easily kill a player with just a few hits. The altar nearby can be used to restore Prayer points .

Elder Chaos druids will never grow tolerant of players, and will remain aggressive even after staying in their tolerance region for ten minutes. Unlike other monsters who engage in monster vs monster combat, elder chaos druids will prioritise players over any zombie pirates that are attacking them.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Elder aquanites are the superior variant of aquanites . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Elder aquanites have a special attack that disables protection prayers, which can occur when having Protect from Magic active for an extended period; as such, briefly disabling it after every attack will help avoid it. If the special attack occurs, it deals a guaranteed hit dealing up to 50 damage, alongside a game message stating The aquanite disables your protection prayers!
Like normal aquanites, hitting it once with slash attack style reduces its stab defence.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Elder custodian stalkers are Slayer monsters that require level 76 Slayer to kill. They are found in the Stalker Den near Auburnvale . They are an elder version of the strange creature fought during the quest Shadows of Custodia . They drop the unique alchemist's signet as well as the antler guard .

Elder custodian stalkers primarily attack with melee. Once they reach 20% health, they can perform a special attack where they stomp the ground and douse the player in spores. The attack can miss or be blocked by Protect from Magic , but if it hits, it will cause the player to bleed for 9 total damage over 15 ticks (9 seconds). It is the same as the bleed applied by Vardorvis ' attacks and can stack. If the player moves while bleeding, additional bleed damage will occur on every tick they are moving.

Overall, it is recommended to use Protect from Melee , as the guaranteed 9 damage from the special attack is relatively minor compared to damage that would be taken from melee over the course of a kill. Gear with high magic defence, such as dragonhide armour , can be beneficial to reduce the chances of taking damage from this attack. Bones to Peaches can also allow the player to sustain longer trips with only prayer gear and potions.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The Flawed Golem is one of the golems found in the Ruins of Camdozaal . It can be found by awakening the Rubble lying in the section south of the bank chest.
When you walk far away from an awakened golem without killing it, it will disintegrate as if it died, without dropping any loot.

Only one golem may be awakened and fought at a time. Attempting to awaken another while one is already active will display the message You're already in combat with a golem. There's no time to awaken another.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Flesh Crawlers are medium level monsters found in the second level of the Stronghold of Security . They drop the bottom of sceptre , one of four parts of the skull sceptre . Flesh crawlers drop herbs often, and are frequently killed for their uncommon grimy ranarr drops.
They are scavengers, and will eat anything if given the chance. [ 1 ]

Flesh crawlers are aggressive to any level players. Ranged is a good style to use as there are safespots in the rooms, such as in the south-west corner of the south-east room. It is possible to hide behind non-aggressive giant rats in one room and range the flesh crawlers, protected from their rapid, albeit weak, attacks. Their attack speed is three ticks, or equivalent to the goblin paint cannon . Because these attacks max at 1 damage, using a regen bracelet can help to offset much of the damage taken, especially if the player has a strong defence.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Flight Kilisa is one of the aviansie bodyguards of Kree'arra , along with Wingman Skree and Flockleader Geerin . She uses melee attacks with a max hit of 15 hitpoints .

She is widely regarded as being the most problematic of the three bodyguards, as Ranged armour provides only a mediocre amount of protection against her slash based melee attacks. Fortunately, in a team setting, she switches targets often, and as a result spends a significant portion of time traversing between players as she attempts to reach the melee distance of her new target. As such, having players distant from each other would minimise the threat Flight Kilisa poses.
The ability to be assigned aviansie by Konar quo Maten , Chaeldar , Nieve , and Duradel can be purchased for 80 slayer reward points , which allows the use for the bonuses of the slayer helmet (i) .

Like other crabs , they are popular for low intensity combat training due to their high hitpoints and low damage output.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Frost naguas are Slayer monsters that require level 48 Slayer to kill. They are found in the Ruins of Tapoyauik , accessed from the Twilight Temple , after completion of the The Heart of Darkness quest.
As with their sulphurous and earthen counterparts, Frost Nagua have -4 flat armour , so all successful hits will do an extra 4 damage to them.

Protect from Magic will negate all damage from their basic attacks. Following 6-7 basic attacks after spawning, the Frost Nagua will mark the ground under the player's feet with icicles, which will erupt after a short period, draining some of the player's prayer. This can be dodged by stepping onto another tile. This attack pattern then repeats.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Frost dragons are a type of adult dragon located in the dungeon on the island of Grimstone , requiring 87 Sailing to access. A combat level of 85 is required to be assigned them as a slayer task, along with the Sailing requirement to access the island. Once players have moored on the island at least once, it can also be accessed via fairy ring code D L P .

Like chromatic dragons , frost dragons attack with melee and short-ranged dragonfire . However, they differ in several respects: their melee defences are weakest to crush, then stab, rather than stab alone; they have a 100% elemental weakness to fire spells rather than 50% to water spells; and while heavy ranged remains the best ranged option, they are more resistant to ranged attacks overall. As with all dragons, they are weak to dragonbane weapons .

Additionally, their dragonfire is considered icy , and will briefly freeze the player if they do not have adequate protection. This icy dragonfire can be partially negated by a regular antifire potion , or fully negated using either a regular antifire potion with an anti-dragon shield , or with a super antifire potion alone. Because they only use melee and short-ranged dragonfire, frost dragons can be safespotted .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Fumus is one of the four mages guarding Nex in the Ancient Prison , within the God Wars Dungeon . Having mastered smoke magic , he enhances Nex's powers over smoke. As with all of Nex's mages, he is immobile.
Fumus is invulnerable to damage until Nex reaches below 80% of her hitpoints. This is indicated by her shouting, Fumus, don't fail me!
He attacks using Smoke Barrage and can poison players, although players are usually using antipoison anyway since Nex can also poison.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Gargoyles are Slayer monsters located in the Slayer Tower 's top floor and basement, requiring 75 Slayer in order to be harmed. Those found in the basement are only available to players who are assigned gargoyles as their Slayer task . If they attempt to kill them off-task, Raulyn will prevent them from attacking.

Gargoyles, like rockslugs , cannot be killed normally. In order to kill a gargoyle, a rock hammer , a rock thrownhammer , or a granite hammer must be used when they reach 8 or lower Hitpoints . Normally, the item must be used on the gargoyle, but players can buy the " Gargoyle Smasher " perk from Slayer Masters for 120 Slayer points , which will automatically smash the gargoyle when it falls to 9 or lower Hitpoints, provided that the player has a rock hammer (or equivalent) in their inventory. The granite hammer will automatically smash gargoyles even without the perk if it is equipped.
Because of the number of rune item drops, it is recommended to bring High Level Alchemy runes to reduce the frequency of banking and save inventory space.

Unlike normal rockslugs, the giant rockslug has a flat armour value of 2, meaning that it will not take damage from attacks that deal that much or lower damage.

In addition to 100% drops and tertiary drops, superior slayer monsters will always roll 3 additional items, of which only 1 roll may be from the superior unique table. The other rolls are performed on the regular counterpart's table; their displayed drop chances represent a single roll.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Greater nechryael are stronger variants of nechryael that require level 80 Slayer to harm, plus completion of Priest in Peril to be assigned as a Slayer task . Krystilia will only assign them if I Wildy More Slayer is unlocked. They are found within the Catacombs of Kourend , Iorwerth Dungeon and the Wilderness Slayer Cave .

Like normal nechryael, greater nechryael can summon up to two Death spawns when fighting a player. These death spawns are the same as the ones summoned by normal nechryael. Using Protect from Melee is recommended, as the greater nechryael is more accurate and deals even more damage. Emberlight can be very effective against greater nechryael, as these are considered to be demonic creatures .

Unlike the twisted banshee , mutated bloodveld , deviant spectre and warped jellies , who have unique superior creatures compared to their standard counterparts, greater nechryael do not. They simply get the normal nechryarch instead, although its drop table is adjusted accordingly.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The greater abyssal demon is a superior variant of the abyssal demon . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Periodically, the greater abyssal demon will teleport around the player four times, increasing its attack speed to 1 (0.6 seconds) for the duration of the teleport. Each of these attacks will always land as a successful hit that is very likely to deal over 20 damage, which can quickly kill a player if they are not paying attention. Using Protect from Melee will prevent damage. The demon will only use this attack when in melee range, and it unlike its lesser brethren, does not teleport itself or the player outside of this attack.
Like all demons, the greater abyssal demon is weak against demonbane weapons .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Grimy Lizards are slayer monsters that require level 44 Slayer to kill, who are found in the Streambound Cavern within Neypotzli and the Tonali Cavern . They can be killed as part of a lizard Slayer task.

Unlike desert lizards , grimy lizards do not require ice coolers to finish off, nor are special footwear required like for sulphur lizards ; however, they are poisonous , and partial completion of the Perilous Moons quest is required. While quest completion isn't necessary, the room remains instanced until progressing further in the quest. If the lizards do not re-spawn, travel to another part of the dungeon and return.

Grimy lizards have -2 flat armour , so all successful hits will do an extra 2 damage to them. This incentivises using faster weapons, or weapons with multiple hitsplats , such as the sulphur blades or the dual macuahuitl .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Gryphons are Slayer monsters requiring 51 Slayer to kill. They inhabit the Great Conch and require completion of the Troubled Tortugans quest and 45 Sailing to access. Wings Spread must be unlocked at a slayer master for 80 points to be given as a task by Nieve or Duradel . You can also get this task from Chaeldar , Vannaka or Mortimer without unlocking them with points as long as the quest is completed. They commonly attack Tortugans .

Gryphons attack with melee and have a special attack allowing them to knock back players with too low of an equipped weight with a threshold of 30kg. If the player's equipped weight meets this threshold, a gryphon using the special attack will be stunned instead; additionally, the player may click the Gryphon within 2 ticks of it being stunned to knock it back one tile and perform one additional attack free of attack delay. Unlike the boss and superior variants, the player will not be punished for missing this counter-attack. Despite its use in the prerequisite quest, a tortugan shield does not have to be equipped while fighting normal gryphons. It is, however, required for both the superior and boss variants and is generally recommended due to its considerable weight. Gryphons have an elemental weakness to air spells , but melee is typically a stronger option, especially considering that melee armour is typically heavier.

With the Slayer reward Bigger and Badder unlocked for 50 Slayer reward points , there is a chance for their superior version, the dire gryphon , to spawn. It has the same mechanics as regular gryphons, except the players will take guaranteed damage after every hit if a tortugan shield is not equipped.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Prifddinas guards can be found near each of the four main Prifddinas entrances, as well as in the Prifddinas Marketplace in the Meilyr district. They are notable for having the highest combat level of any guard of any city in Gielinor . They can be killed as an alternative for an elf Slayer task .

For Slayer tasks, the guards in Prifddinas may be favourable over the elf warriors and archers found in Lletya due to their spawns being much closer together and in open spaces. The archers, however, have slightly less slash Defence and slightly higher Ranged Defence.

It is possible to trap all three of the guards that roam the Prifddinas Marketplace in the Meilyr district. This method relies on the guards staying aggressive towards the player, which prevents them from wandering back into the marketplace. Because of the small wandering range of the southernmost guard, the other two guards must be trapped first, otherwise the southern guard loses aggression while trapping the other guards.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The guardian drake is a superior variant of the drake . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Guardian drakes have two special attacks. They share the same special attack as regular drakes, launching volcanic breath at the player that hits four times in quick succession for up to 8 damage each. Players can dodge this attack by moving one tile away before the volcanic breath lands.

Guardian drakes may also attack with a special melee attack which stuns the player and is capable of hitting over 30 damage. This attack hits through prayer but can be avoided if the player steps out of melee range quickly enough; it can be predicted by the yellow gaps on the back lighting up. This special attack is only used when the player is in melee distance. Unlike regular drakes, the volcanic breath special is only used when the player is not in melee distance.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Harpie bug swarms are mid-level slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 33 to kill. A lit bug lantern , which requires a Firemaking level of 33 to light, is required to damage these monsters (the lantern must be lit and equipped). If you do not have 33 Firemaking, you cannot be assigned harpie bug swarms as a Slayer task . [ 1 ]

Harpie bug swarms should be an easy task for well-equipped mid-level players; their abundance as well as the fact that they remain aggressive to players until level 93 combat makes this task very click-easy. As harpie bug swarms are very accurate, and will often hit for up to 6 Hitpoints , it is advisable to have Defence levels from 40-50+ and to bring food appropriate for the player's level, such as lobsters . Another option is to keep Protect from Melee up and recharge prayer at the relatively nearby altars.
It is recommended to bring nature runes while slaying this monster since it has many drops that can be alched to free up inventory spaces, and fire runes are frequently dropped from this monster.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Hydras are draconic creatures found in the lower level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon in Mount Karuulm , requiring level 95 Slayer to kill. They were created by a dragonkin named Karuulm as a project which is not based on any prior work done by his fellow kin.

Hydras are only assigned as a Slayer task by Konar and Mortimer . There are two areas within the dungeon that contain hydras, one being exclusive to players on a hydra Slayer assignment. As both of these are located within the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon, players who have not completed the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary must wear boots of stone , boots of brimstone , or granite boots to protect themselves from the extreme heat of the dungeon floor, or else they will take rapid damage.

Killing a hydra is a requirement for the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary . The Alchemical Hydra boss is task-only, but the normal Hydras on the lower level of Mount Karuulm are not, so the achievement can be achieved by boosting from as low as level 90 Slayer using a wild pie , or other temporary skill boost .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Ice troll females are most commonly found near the smaller ice troll runts . They use powerful Ranged attacks that hit hard and fast. The damage dealt by these females can be reduced to 2 by equipping a Neitiznot shield made during The Fremennik Isles . However, the shield doesn't affect the accuracy of the attacks. Their accuracy seem to neglect all defence bonuses from stats and equipment; hence, they almost always are able to deal some damage. Despite possessing melee stats, ice troll females do not make use of it.

The ice troll female drop table is somewhat unusual in that it varies depending on the exact version of monster being killed, while having identical appearances in-game. There are two different drop tables, with the drop table used determined by the troll's spawn point. Variant 1 is a table unique to ice trolls, and variant 2 is a table that will drop nothing but bones. This variant is also only 50% weak to fire. There is only one variant 2 in existence, who spawns just south of the East Fremennik Isles mine . A third variant, the frenzied ice troll female , do not drop any loot and should not be killed as well.
Drop rates are estimated based on 2,280,172 samples from the Drop Rate Project , unless otherwise cited.

A second variant, the frenzied ice troll grunt , does not drop the granite shield and rune kiteshield that may be sought after by players, and should not be killed if seeking those items.

The ice troll male drop table is somewhat unusual in that it varies depending on the exact version of monster being killed, while having identical appearances in-game. There are two different drop tables, with the drop table used determined by the troll's spawn point. Variant 1 is a table unique to ice trolls, and variant 2 is the low-level troll table used by mountain trolls . There are only two of variant 2 in existence, who spawn just south of the East Fremennik Isles mine . Variant 2 also only has a 50% weakness to fire. A third variant, the frenzied ice troll male , do not drop any loot and should not be killed as well.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Ice troll runts are the lowest levels of Ice trolls found on Jatizso and Neitiznot . Despite possessing only a slightly higher combat level than Mountain trolls , they can hit much harder (up to 17) and are much more aggressive, often attempting to engage the player from several squares away. They also have the ability to hit through armour, similar to Verac the Defiled . Yak-hide armour does not reduce the troll's maximum hit. It is advised to use the Protect from Melee prayer whenever engaging more than one at a time. Ice troll runts are often found near Ice troll females ; when they're not, they will be spread farther out.

Ice troll runts are found on the northern isle with the rest of the ice trolls, and in the cave systems (the eastern cave before completion of The Fremennik Isles , and the western cave after). They're also found south of the bridge to the troll isle just north-west of Neitiznot . In this location, they tend to engage in combat with the Honour guards just east of the bridge. While they prefer to attack the guards, they will attack a player if the player is their first target, until they grow tolerant of the player.

The player can receive aid from guards slaying ice troll runts on a troll task while killing them quickly with a dwarf multicannon . However, if a guard deals the finishing blow or attacks a runt as it dies in the same tick as the player, the Slayer experience gained will be halved but items will still be dropped.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Ice warriors are mid-level ice elementals. [ 1 ] They have a 100% elemental weakness to fire spells . Ice warriors can be assigned by Krystilia for a Wilderness Slayer task , or by Vannaka or Mazchna for normal tasks.
Kamil fought during Desert Treasure I is considered an ice warrior for a Slayer assignment.

Ice warriors have good accuracy and can cut through Ranged and Magic armour with ease. They also seem to have higher levels of aggression than many other mobs as they'll often engage the player from a rather long distance. If using melee, wearing at least adamant or rune armour and using high quality food is advised.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Infernal Mages are Slayer monsters that require 45 Slayer to kill. They are mainly hunted for their unique drops: the fire ruby , and the rare dark mystic boots and hat drops, and are sometimes hunted for their frequent drops of death runes . Players who plan on fighting them should be wary of their accurate magic attack, although Protect from Magic negates this completely.

To reach the Infernal Mage area in the 1 st floor [ UK ] 2 nd floor [ US ] of the Slayer Tower , players can take the long way up the south-east stairs, which requires running past aggressive Banshees , so wearing Earmuffs or a Slayer helmet is recommended. Players with 18 Agility can avoid the banshees by using the broken window shortcut for quick access to the stairs.

After completion of Song of the Elves , Iorwerth Warriors can also be found in the Iorwerth Dungeon . In the dungeon, Iorwerth Warriors can easily be safespotted with ranged damage across the fire pit in the north-east of the room near the entrance.

As the warriors use polearms , they have an attack range of two tiles, and players should take note of this if safespotting them. Although they are not normally aggressive, Iorwerth Warriors will attack the player during stages of Song of the Elves .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Jellies are Slayer monsters found in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon and Wilderness Slayer Cave that require a Slayer level of 52 to kill. They give 75 Slayer experience per kill and drop hard clue scrolls and steel weaponry . Jellies and their variants are the only creatures to drop mithril boots .

They attack with magical acids that bypass physical defences [ 1 ] (a magic-based melee attack); therefore high magic defence armour, such as dragonhide is effective against their attacks. However, Protect from Melee will prevent all damage from them.

In the Wilderness cave jellies may only be attacked while on a Slayer task . Here they can be safespotted by using either side of the rockfall in the southern part of the cave, which the Jellies will not wander away from. It is also possible to safespot them by standing on the corner of the rocks in the western section of the chamber or from behind the stones in the hallway south of the jelly chamber.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Killerwatts are Slayer monsters located in the Killerwatt plane , accessible through a portal at the top floor of Draynor Manor after completion of Ernest the Chicken . A Slayer level of 37 is required to kill them.

If a player is not wearing a pair of insulated boots while fighting them, both their Ranged and Melee attacks will have a much higher maximum hit. Even when wearing insulated boots, their attacks are still rapid and highly accurate, and they have an attack range of 13 tiles, meaning it is not possible to safespot them with long ranged weapons. A dwarf multicannon cannot be set up in the Killerwatt plane .
Killerwatts are a commonly skipped Slayer task due to their relatively high damage output combined with their mediocre drops, except for those seeking their unique air diamond drop.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: King Sand Crabs are aggressive monsters that look like sandy boulders while disguised, but attack when walked by. They are found inside the Catacombs of Kourend in the south-east section of the dungeon, as well as the Crabclaw Caves found south-east of the Woodcutting Guild .

As their name suggests, these crabs are significantly tougher with better combat stats. Like their rock cousins , king sand crabs can drop components needed to make Rock-shell armour , along with the rock-shell gloves and rock-shell boots . Given that their stats are lower compared to their rock cousins (having only slightly more health but much lower stats), it is recommended to kill King Sand Crabs instead if seeking these drops.
Drop rates are estimated based on 42,653 samples from the Drop Rate Project , unless otherwise cited. The average King Sand Crab kill is worth 1,445.95 .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Kraka is a level 91 troll found on Death Plateau . Like the rest of the "big, bad" trolls in the area, such as Stick , Pee Hat , and Rock , he drops a rune warhammer or granite shield , and as such is commonly hunted by ironmen looking to upgrade their armour .

Kraka has a maximum hit of 23, so it is recommended to use Protect from Melee when fighting him. His wander range allows him to be safespotted by standing near the cliffside, although players can still be attacked by other mountain trolls while in the area.

For those without protection prayers, another way to "safespot" him is to stand near the entrance to the plateau, hit him a couple times before he turns towards you, and then walk outside the spear wall, where the thrower trolls will attack you. Players can then walk back inside and wait for Kraka to lose his aggression and walk back to his usual guard position. Attacking during his walk back allows the player to land a couple free hits before he retaliates and the player has to step outside again.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Kurask are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 70 to kill. Like turoth , they can only be damaged with leaf-bladed weapons , broad ammunition , or the Magic Dart spell due to their tough hides; [ 1 ] they are immune to any other types of attacks. They are, however, susceptible to burn damage from weapons such as burning claws .

Kurask are relatively inaccurate, but they can hit somewhat high if their attacks manage to land. Additionally, they have fast health regeneration, healing one hitpoint every five game ticks . Due to their relative inaccuracy, they can be fought without protection prayers by using Bones to Peaches for healing, though players may wish to activate Protect from Melee if the superior version , the king kurask , spawns.

Although kurask are invulnerable to any damage from the special attacks of Saradomin godsword , ancient godsword , and toxic blowpipe , their healing effects will still activate as if damage had been dealt, making them useful as special attack weapons during extended trips. Likewise, the special attacks of ancient mace and eldritch Nightmare staff will restore prayer points based on what damage would have been dealt. The set effect of Guthan's equipment will not activate against kurask, however.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Lava Strykewyrms are Slayer monsters requiring 62 Slayer to kill, located in the Charred Dungeon beneath Charred Island , requiring 60 Sailing to reach, as well as in the Wyrmscraig Cavern after partial completion of Fallen From Grace . They can be killed as part of a wyrm task, and are known for their dragon metal sheet drop, which is significantly more common when on a wyrm task.

Lava Strykewyrms attack with both melee and ranged . However, they use only melee when attacked from within one tile range of them, and only ranged when attacked from a distance. This means that all damage can be avoided with protection prayers . Fire spells will heal them equal to the amount hit. They are located in a single-way combat area and cannons cannot be used against them. Like wyrms, they are vulnerable to dragonbane weapons such as the dragon hunter lance .

With the Slayer reward Bigger and Badder unlocked for 50 Slayer reward points , there is a chance for their superior version, the magma strykewyrm , to spawn. The Slayer reward Can of Wyrms increases the number of wyrms assigned to 200-250 for the price of 100 Slayer reward points.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Lava dragons are former red dragons that have been transformed after being surrounded by lava for too long. [ 1 ] They reside in the Lava Dragon Isle in the Wilderness (between level 36 and 42 Wilderness), and attack with melee as well as with dragonfire . Due to their low Magic level they are particularly weak to Magic, which combined with their weakness to water spells makes water bolt a slow but profitable method of killing them.

Lava dragons can be safespotted both inside and outside their isle. The many piles of skeletons and edges at the isle allow for players to safespot them inside. Alternatively, players can camp some of the southern spawns outside the isle. Having 74 Agility is recommended when killing them to use the stepping stones to escape the isle, as the area is frequented by player killers .

Bringing a pestle and mortar is optional to grind the scales into shards, in addition to High Level Alchemy runes to alch their common adamant and rune equipment drops. If killing them from outside the isle, Telekinetic Grab will be needed to grab their drops. Although it is possible to stay at the isle indefinitely using this method, it is advisable to bank every 10–20 minutes as the isle is commonly targeted by player killers.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Lizards ( Lacertilia giganteus ) are Slayer monsters found in the Kharidian Desert that require level 22 Slayer to kill. Ice coolers , which can be bought from any Slayer master , are required to kill them. The cooler will be consumed, so multiple coolers are necessary for slayer trips.

They can be killed in place of small lizards or desert lizards on a Slayer task , and are found within the same area as the desert lizards. They will provide more experience on a task than desert lizards.
Players can kill sulphur or grimy lizards as an alternative to desert lizards, provided they have 44 Slayer. Additionally, these types of lizards do not require ice coolers to finish off.
