page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Lizardmen are reptilian humanoids that inhabit the Kebos Lowlands and within the Lizardman Canyon . Secretly created from a native species of lizard during the 37th decade (1,040 years ago) under the rule of King Shayzien VII, he had intended the lizardmen to become his personal army to enforce his tyrannical rule of Great Kourend. After he returned from the dead as Xeric , the lizardmen continued to serve him loyally, seeing him as their god. Today, long after his exile, they still remain loyal, constantly attempting to invade Great Kourend.

Lizardmen can be unlocked as a Slayer task at a cost of 75 Slayer reward points . Once unlocked, they can be assigned by medium and high-level Slayer masters. The slightly stronger lizardman brute and even stronger lizardman shaman also count towards the task. Killing any variant of lizardmen while on a normal Lizard task will NOT progress the task.
Killing a lizardman is a task in the medium Kourend & Kebos Diary .

Three shamans reside in the western area of Lizardman Canyon via the handholds . These three shamans are present in a multi-combat area . Shayzien soldiers will not attack the shamans (nor will the shamans attack them), since they are busy dealing with a small group of normal lizardmen . Below are a couple ways to get there.
Players can check how many players are currently in the western area of the canyon by speaking to the wounded soldier outside the canyon, just south of the broken crossbow.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Long-tailed Wyverns are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 66 in order to be harmed. They reside in the Wyvern Cave on Fossil Island . Like with other Wyverns , an elemental , mind , dragonfire or ancient wyvern shield provides significant protection against their icy breath , and they are vulnerable to the effects of dragonbane weapons .

In addition to their icy breath and Melee attacks, long-tailed wyverns can use a typeless ranged attack that bypasses protection prayers and hits for up to 10 damage. Like taloned Wyverns and ancient Wyverns , they can use their typeless attack while the player is in melee distance. These monsters require completion of the Bone Voyage quest to be assigned as a Slayer task.

The task-only cave entrance is a trapdoor in the Mushroom Forest and the regular cave entrance is south of the Museum Camp . When a player attempts to attack wyverns in the Slayer task area without a Fossil Island wyvern Slayer task , Weve ( Steve 's son) will stop them from doing so.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The magma strykewyrm is the superior variant of the lava strykewyrm . It has a chance of spawning while on a wyrm slayer task, after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Like lava strykewyrms, magma strykewyrms attack with both ranged and melee . Magma strykewyrms also have a special attack, where it burrows to player's location and deals 20+ damage if the player doesn't move away from that location within a few seconds. Note that this special attack can happen even if the player is standing next to a wall, so it cannot be avoided like the lizardman shamans ' similar special attack.
Just like the regular lava strykewyrms, magma strykewyrms can be safespotted by outranging their attacks and will not use its special attack.

The marble gargoyle is a superior variant of the gargoyle . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Unlike most other superior monsters, marble gargoyles use two combat styles: melee and ranged. Both its standard attacks can hit very high, though they are somewhat inaccurate. Players should Protect from Missiles to take the least damage unless wearing equipment with high ranged defence. Attacking from a distance with Protect from Missiles and a magic or ranged weapon negates all damage, excluding the special attack.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The Market Guard is an attackable NPC that guards the stalls in Rellekka Marketplace. They are non-aggressive towards players, but they will attack a player they spot Thieving from the stalls around them. To steal or buy from a stall, the player must become a Fremennik by completing The Fremennik Trials quest. They have an attack speed of 3, being one tick faster than most melee weapons (such as scimitars ).
They have the exact same appearance, stats, and drops as Fremennik warriors , except they wield Fremennik blades instead of warhammers .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Mature custodian stalkers are slayer monsters that require level 67 Slayer to kill. They are found in the Stalker Den near Auburnvale . They are a Mature version of the stalker creature fought during the quest Shadows of Custodia . They drop the unique Antler Guard , as well as broken antlers and huasca seeds .

The custodian stalker has a special attack where they stomp the ground and douse the player in spores. The special attack is performed once the custodian stalker reaches 20% HP. This attack can miss, and also can be blocked by Protect from Magic and causes the player to bleed for 9 damage over 15 game ticks (9 seconds). It is the same as the bleed applied by Vardorvis ' attacks and can stack.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The Mind Golem is one of the golems found in the Ruins of Camdozaal . It can be found by awakening the Rubble lying in the section south of the bank chest, in the enclave containing six piles of rubble that is located east of the Flawed Golems . It is fueled by runic energies and imbued with the power of the nearby Mind Altar . [ 1 ]

Only one golem may be awakened and fought at a time. Attempting to awaken another while one is already active will display the message You're already in combat with a golem. There's no time to awaken another. When you walk away from an awakened golem without killing it, it will disintegrate as if it died, without dropping any loot.
Mind golems are notable for dropping the barronite guard , needed for construction of the barronite mace , and for dropping Mind cores , used in training Runecraft .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Minotaur are found on level one of the Stronghold of Security . They drop the right skull half , one of four parts of the skull sceptre . These monsters are great for training due to their low Defence , but have high attack damage making them dangerous for un-equipped players.
Minotaurs are a common method of Ranged training as they can be safespotted and commonly drop iron arrows.

There are various safespots located in the Stronghold of Security : Vault of War floor. These spots can be found in the following places: In the small centre room south of the room with the spikey chain, by standing on the east side of the north-westernmost skeleton. In the room immediately east to the start of the floor, behind the spiked fences. and in the large south-easternmost room behind the spiked fence.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Mogres are Slayer monsters and a type of ogre that are found in Mudskipper Point , requiring level 32 Slayer to kill. Mogres appear when disturbed by the player, who must lure them using Fishing explosives on an Ominous Fishing Spot . Previously, they could only be killed by players who had completed the Skippy and the Mogres miniquest . Since the release of Sailing , Mogres swimming in the ocean can now be killed with cannons from the player's boat. Doing so does not require completion of Skippy and the Mogres and does not demand the use of Fishing explosives, but still requires having level 32 Slayer.

Mogres can only be "lured" by clicking Use on the fishing explosives in your inventory, then clicking on the ominous fishing spots while also standing a few tiles away. Although the ominous fishing spots do have an options to "Lure" or "Bait", both these options do nothing (even with fishing explosives) and instead merely say in chat "Something seems to have scared all the fishes away..."
Mogres are usually killed by players searching for their unique drops of flippers or Mudskipper hats .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Mogres are monsters that can be found in the Ardent Ocean . Like the ones found on land , they require level 32 Slayer to fight. This requirement cannot be bypassed by having a crewmate man a cannon .
Any boat with an adamant keel or better will not take any damage from mogres.
The player may be assigned to kill them as a bounty task starting at 30 Sailing . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from Ardougne .

^ 1.0 1.1 Only dropped while on an applicable bounty task .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Molanisks are Slayer monsters that require level 39 Slayer to kill giving 52 Slayer experience per kill. A Slayer bell is necessary to initiate combat with them. Since they are only found in the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon , completion of Death to the Dorgeshuun is required to fight molanisks and it is advisable to bring a light source . Molanisks do unusually low damage, meaning a player with half-decent armour should easily be able to kill them with no trouble.
They are mainly hunted for their earth emerald drop, or as a Slayer assignment from Vannaka .

Molanisks are found attached to cave walls and must be lured off with a Slayer bell to allow players to attack them. The Slayer bell only works within 3 tiles of the wall the molanisk is attached to. When lured off the wall, they are aggressive towards the player who lured them off with the bell. Molanisks respawn relatively quickly, so players who want to conserve run energy can just stay at the same respawn location. Alternatively, there is a spot south of the fairy ring with two spawns close together.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Moonlight Cockatrice are Slayer monsters that require level 25 Slayer to kill, who are found in the Earthbound Cavern within Neypotzli which requires level 48 Slayer for partial completion of Perilous Moons to enter. Please note that if you have only partially completed Perilous Moons to access them for a slayer task, they will not re-spawn on their own after being killed. You must leave the room and re-enter before they will re-spawn. Additionally, when using a cannon with the partial completion Perilous Moons , when leaving for them to re-spawn, make sure you pick the cannon up before leaving, otherwise the cannon will be instantly degraded and must be collected from Nulodian in Falador.

A mirror shield or V's shield is required to defend against their piercing gaze, or else they will reduce your combat stats every hit, even while safespotting. Their drops are almost identical to those of the regular cockatrice , only dropping slightly higher quantities of runes, though they provide more Slayer experience per kill.
They share the same superior as the cockatrice, the Cockathrice .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Mutated Bloodvelds are stronger variants of bloodvelds that require level 50 Slayer to kill. They are found within the Catacombs of Kourend , Iorwerth Dungeon , Meiyerditch Laboratories , and Buccaneers' Laboratory .

Like regular bloodvelds, a mutated bloodveld's attacks are magic-based melee . They are known to damage frequently due to their high attack level, so equipping armour with high Magic defence is recommended to mitigate their attacks. They can also be safespotted with ease. Alternatively, players can opt to wear Prayer equipment while using the Protect from Melee prayer, using prayer potions instead of food. Players can also teleport to an altar and then teleport back to the Catacombs instead of using prayer potions, since these bloodvelds are so close to the entrance.

Mutated bloodvelds are popular for players willing to spend time completing their task, as they provide better experience than normal bloodvelds. They also drop blood runes at a higher rate compared to normal bloodvelds, in addition to the ancient shard and dark totem pieces they drop in the Catacombs of Kourend and the crystal shards they drop in the Iorwerth Dungeon . On average, a player can expect to receive 3.6 blood runes per mutated bloodveld kill.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Nechryael are demons of decay [ 1 ] which require a Slayer level of 80 in order to harm, plus completion of Priest in Peril to be assigned as a Slayer task . They are found in the Slayer Tower and Charred Dungeon , and their stronger variant, Greater nechryael , can be found in the Catacombs of Kourend , Iorwerth Dungeon , and the Wilderness Slayer Cave . Nechryael are known for their rune boots drop, which are one of the few boots to provide a Strength bonus when worn. They are also known for their frequent drop rates of seeds and combat runes .

Commonly, nechryael summon death spawns to aid them, up to a limit of two each per nechryael. Death spawns have semi-inaccurate attacks with a max hit of 2, and their attacks can hit through Protect from Melee . Auto-retaliate does not work on them, so you will have to click the death spawn to attack it. Death spawns will not be summoned if the nechryael is unable to attack the player back (such as when being safespotted ). The death spawns will stop attacking any player who moves more than 7 tiles away from them, which is useful when fighting the more powerful nechryarch . In the Slayer Tower there are many tables and buckets, which can easily be used to safespot Nechryael.

Emberlight can be very effective against nechryael, as they are considered to be demonic creatures. Their stronger variant, greater nechryael , are more commonly killed with Ice Burst or Ice Barrage in the Catacombs of Kourend .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The nechryarch is a superior variant of nechryael and greater nechryael . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer master .

Like nechryael, nechryarch can summon minions to assist it in battle. It will summon 3 chaotic death spawns , with each one attacking with magic, ranged and melee. These spawns hit harder, but their attacks can be successfully prayed against. Like normal death spawns, they ignore combat restrictions . As players will be subjected to all three forms of combat with very high damage, a common tactic is to run away from the spawns until they lose interest and repeat until the nechryarch dies. Alternatively, they can be killed with area-of-effect attacks in the Catacombs of Kourend .
Like their standard counterparts, the chaotic death spawns will not be summoned if the nechryarch is unable to attack the player back (such as when being safespotted ).

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The night beast is a superior variant of the dark beast . It has a chance of spawning after purchasing the unlock Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points from any Slayer Master . Unlike their normal variants, a night beast's initial attack is always magic, regardless if the player hits it first or if it made to aggro with a goading potion . It will always attempt to melee the player unless they cannot reach them, in which they will begin using magic until this no longer occurs.

The night beast has a special attack where it will briefly stop attacking then it uses Magic for three attacks which resemble Fire Blast , covering a 3x3 area dealing damage equal to 1/3 of the player's current Hitpoints (rounded down). If the player is below 3 hitpoints the special attack's damage will round down to 0 so it is incapable of killing you [ 1 ] (note that this rounding does not apply to the standard magic attack the night beast will do when first attacked by the player or when the player is out of melee range). The simplest strategy is to use the protection from melee prayer and let the special attacks hit you, making sure you do not leave the monster's melee range.

In addition to 100% drops and tertiary drops, superior Slayer monsters will always roll 3 additional items, of which only 1 roll may be from the superior unique table. The other rolls are performed on the regular counterpart's table; their displayed drop chances represent a single roll.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Ogress Warriors are found in the Corsair Cove Dungeon . They are a good way for free-to-play ironmen to obtain rune battleaxes and rune full helms , as well as law and nature runes .
Note that they have somewhat higher defence than lesser demons (especially magical defence), so 45+ Ranged or 13+ Magic is recommended if you are safespotting.
They can be used as an effective alternative to Ogres for a Slayer task, as the Corsair Cove Resource Area entrance is typically not crowded on members worlds.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Pee Hat is a level 91 troll found on Death Plateau . Like the rest of the "big, bad" trolls in the area, such as Stick , Kraka , and Rock , he drops a rune warhammer or granite shield , and as such is commonly hunted by ironmen looking to upgrade their armour .

Pee Hat has a maximum hit of 23, so it is recommended to use Protect from Melee when fighting him. His wander range allows him to be safespotted by standing near the cliffside, although players can still be attacked by other mountain trolls while in the area.

For those without protection prayers, another way to "safespot" him is to stand near the entrance to the plateau, hit him a couple times before he turns towards you, and then walk outside the spear wall, where the thrower trolls will attack you. Players can then walk back inside and wait for Kraka to lose his aggression and walk back to his usual guard position. Attacking during his walk back allows the player to land a couple free hits before he retaliates and the player has to step outside again. Damage from the thrower trolls can also be avoided by climbing the rocks east of the entrance and losing aggression with climbing boots, or standing far east on Death Plateau.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Pyrefiends are demons made of fire and molten rock [ 1 ] that require level 30 Slayer to kill. As their attacks are magic based, it is recommended to wear armour with a high magic defence bonus, such as dragonhide . Pyrefiends and Harpie bug swarms are the only monsters to drop steel boots .
If the Bigger and Badder slayer reward is unlocked, there is a chance for a flaming pyrelord to appear upon killing a pyrefiend on slayer task.

The pyrefiends on the Isle of Souls are close by a cage/harpoon fishing spot. The fires with the examine text 'Hot!' around their spawn can be used for cooking the fish. This is useful for restricted accounts, as well for extending trips if needed.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Pyrelords are stronger variants of pyrefiends that require level 30 Slayer to kill. They are found within the Sisterhood Sanctuary and on the north side of the Isle of Souls .

On the Isle of Souls , there are 10 Pyrefiends and 3 Pyrelords on the northern part of the island, close to the fairy ring code B J P . They can be safespotted by putting a tree between the player and the pyrelord. Unlike pyrefiends, which are 1x1 size monsters, pyrelords are 2x2. This can result in getting the pyrelord stuck behind trees or other obstacles which the player can attack without being hit.
The closest bank is accessible in the Shayzien Encampment by using fairy ring code D J R to the Chasm of Fire or by using the Soul Wars Minigame Teleport .

Like all revenants, they can restore their health when it falls below 50% and will react to a player's protection prayers; wearing a charged bracelet of ethereum will reduce all revenants' damage by 75%.
The Salve amulet can be a good option for killing revenants due to the damage bonus it provides while being easily replaceable, as PKing in the Revenant Caves is extremely common.
Revenant cyclopes cannot be killed as an alternative for a hill giant Slayer task .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Rockslugs are Slayer monsters that require level 20 Slayer to kill. A bag of salt must be used on it when it has 4 or less Hitpoints to finish it off. If used on a rockslug with 5 or more Hitpoints, the bag will be consumed but have no effect. If a rockslug's health is reduced to 1 but a bag of salt is not used on it, the rockslug will stop retaliating and wander off.

Players can buy the " Slug salter " perk from a Slayer Master for 10 Slayer points , which will automatically salt the rockslug when it falls below 4 Hitpoints, provided that the player has a bag of salt in their inventory. Alternatively, a brine sabre can be used to kill them without the need for bags of salt.
They are rarely killed due to their mediocre drops, which consists of low level ores and seeds . They may rarely drop the mystic gloves (light) .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Rune dragons are metal dragons first encountered during Dragon Slayer II , in which the player must fight one during Zorgoth 's assault. After completion of the quest , they can be found in the eastern chamber of the Lithkren Vault .

To get back to the laboratory underneath Lithkren , players can travel using the rowboat from the quest on the west side of Fossil Island or, after completion, taking a digsite pendant and using it on the strange machine north of the rune dragon room, adding a teleport straight to Lithkren on it.

Rune dragons are the result of a side project of Zorgoth's after being inspired by another dragonkin , Forcae , which involves infusing dragon eggs with various metals. While Forcae's metal dragons were created to find a solution to the dragonkin's infertility, Zorgoth had bred his metal dragons for his war against humanity .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Sea snake hatchlings are found in the Miscellania and Etceteria dungeon , which can be entered during and after the Royal Trouble quest. A Slayer level of 40 is required to receive a sea snakes Slayer task, but they can be killed at any level. The snakes are poisonous , with the poison starting at 5 damage. Players fighting them should bring poison protection of some sort, such as an antipoison , antipoison+ , or antipoison++ . They attack with Melee and are vulnerable to Magic , particularly earth spells . Their unique drop is the water sapphire , which is shared with the sea snake young .

Players can use the blue eggs halfway through the tunnel as a safespot , although it is hard to get them to the player due to being a little further away than the sea snake young . A Dwarf multicannon can be used, but with reduced effectiveness due to the area being single-way combat .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Skeletal wyverns are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 72 in order to be harmed. They are found at the end of the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon . There is a shortcut at the ladder to the Ice Dungeon leading to the skeletal wyverns requiring level 82 Agility (or level 77 Agility with a Summer pie ). Like other wyverns , they require an elemental shield , mind shield , dragonfire shield , dragonfire ward , or ancient wyvern shield to reduce damage from their icy breath ; however, it is not required to be slain. They are also the only monster that drop granite legs .

Although Tarn in his diary writes that he believes skeletal wyverns are undead , they are actually magically animated remains, [ 1 ] different from actual undead creatures. This means that the Salve amulet and its enchanted versions do not work against them. They originate from Fossil Island , having escaped the island via magic. [ 2 ] Additionally, their bones radiate a very weak magical aura, and stay colder than room temperature. [ 3 ]

Skeletal wyverns are assigned by the Slayer masters Chaeldar , Konar , Nieve , and Duradel/Kuradal . Because an elemental shield or better is required to defend against their icy breath, they will only assign them if the player has completed the Elemental Workshop I quest . [ 4 ]

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The smoke devil is a stronger variant of the dust devil , and can be found exclusively in the Smoke Devil Dungeon . These require a minimum of 93 Slayer and an active Slayer task to be harmed. A slayer helmet , slayer helmet (i) , or a facemask is required to kill these. This monster, along with its boss variant and superior variant , are the only monsters to drop the occult necklace . However, only the boss variant drops the smoke battlestaff .

Smoke devils reside in a multi-combat area , so players can burst / barrage or use chinchompas on them, though only the former is particularly effective. Given the fact that the smoke devil chamber is very large, bringing a cannon is recommended to get their attention. The various remains that litter the chamber act as "walls", so smoke devils can be stacked on top of one another for bursting/barraging quickly by hiding behind a pile of remains.
When fighting them, using Protect from Missiles will negate their attacks.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The Spiritual mage is a potent Magic Slayer monster found in the God Wars Dungeon . Like all monsters there, they are aggressive to any players that do not wear items showing loyalty to their god. Spiritual mages require 83 Slayer to kill. Completion of Death Plateau is required before Spiritual creatures can be assigned as a Slayer task . [ 1 ] Just like Spiritual rangers and Spiritual warriors , which require 63 and 68 Slayer respectively, there are spiritual mages for each god, and each one has unique stats.

Slaying a Spiritual mage in the God Wars Dungeon is a requirement for the Elite Fremennik Diary and slaying a Spiritual mage in the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon is a requirement for the Elite Wilderness Diary .

Spiritual mages are best known for their dragon boots drop. They have fairly poor drops otherwise, with the original four god mages dropping a small supply of various runes. The Zarosian mages have a vastly improved drop table; more runes are dropped, particularly combination runes , high-level herbs, a slightly increased drop rate of clue scrolls and most notably, the signature dragon boots are a tertiary drop from them.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Spiritual rangers are powerful Ranged Slayer monsters found in the God Wars Dungeon . There are five types of spiritual rangers: Saradominists , Zamorakians , Bandosians , Armadyleans , and Zarosians . Spiritual rangers require 63 Slayer to kill, and the Troll Stronghold quest must be partially complete to gain access to the God Wars Dungeon. Spiritual creatures cannot be given as a Slayer task if the player has not completed the Death Plateau quest.
As with all other spiritual creatures , their stats and combat capabilities vary.

The Zarosian variant can perform a unique attack, launching an arrow into the air that will fall down on the player's position when the attack was used. If not dodged, it will deal 35+ damage and disable overhead protection prayers for a few ticks.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The Spiritual warrior is a powerful Slayer monster found in the God Wars Dungeon . There are five types of spiritual warriors: Saradominists , Zamorakians , Bandosians , Armadyleans , and Zarosians . Spiritual warriors require 68 Slayer to kill (note Spiritual creatures cannot be given as a Slayer task if the player has not completed the Death Plateau quest). Just like Spiritual rangers and Spiritual mages , there are Spiritual warriors from each god.
Spiritual warriors frequently drop mithril equipment , adamant equipment , and rune equipment , so it is advisable to bring runes for High Level Alchemy .

The Zarosian variant has a special attack where they will summon four smoke clouds around the player, which slowly move in to their location over 5 ticks. If the player does not step away from the spot, they will be hit for a substantial amount of hitpoints (up to 40). This special can hit players safe-spotting.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Spitting wyverns are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 66 in order to be harmed. They reside in the Wyvern Cave on Fossil Island and are the weakest of the Fossil Island wyverns . Like with other Wyverns , an elemental , mind , dragonfire ward , dragonfire , or ancient wyvern shield (not including Anti-dragon Shield ) provides significant protection against their icy breath . These monsters require completion of the Bone Voyage quest to be assigned as a Slayer task. Additionally, players can benefit from using dragonbane weapons to deal additional damage per second.

Unlike their skeletal variant, spitting wyverns can use their icy breath from any distance. They will use Ranged when attacking from a distance, and will not try to use melee unless the target is in melee range. Their Ranged attack is weak; however, it may hit the player multiple times if it is a successful hit .

The task-only cave entrance is a trapdoor in the Mushroom Forest and the regular cave entrance is south of the Museum Camp . When a player attempts to attack wyverns in the Slayer task area without a Fossil Island wyvern Slayer task , Weve ( Steve 's son) will stop them from doing so.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Starlight the unicorn is a bodyguard of Commander Zilyana , along with Growler and Bree . She uses powerful melee attacks to bring down her enemies, which has a max hit of 15. She is the strongest Unicorn in the game.

Starlight has a special mechanic that allows her to move randomly while underneath Commander Zilyana . This random movement can stack with normal pathing to get to the player, which can result in Starlight effectively running (moving 2 tiles within the same tick).

To the south-east is the Saradomin section. To enter, you must have at least 70 Agility (not boostable) and two pieces of rope to tie around rocks to enter each of the two areas. These ropes are permanent so you will only need to attach them the first time you enter this area. The monsters in this section will use mostly magic -based attacks. Once in the general's room, Starlight will attack with melee. Remember to always use Protect from Magic as Commander Zilyana will attack you.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Sulphur lizards are creatures found in the middle level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon in Mount Karuulm , requiring level 44 Slayer to kill. As they are only found within the volcano, players must wear the boots of stone , boots of brimstone , or granite boots to protect themselves from the extreme heat of the dungeon floor, unless they've completed the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary .
Players can kill these as an alternative to desert lizards , provided they have the higher Slayer level. Additionally, sulphur lizards do not require ice coolers to finish off.
They can be safespotted by standing by the corner of the entrance to their room. A cannon placed nearby can easily draw the lizards in.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Sulphur nagua are slayer monsters that require level 48 Slayer to kill. They are found in the Ancient Prison within Neypotzli , accessed from the south-west entrance of the antechamber. Partial completion of Perilous Moons is required for access.

Their attacks are unique in that they hit twice per attack, rolling damage normally and splitting it in two hitsplats . After five attacks they will use a special attack in which they raise their weapon, and if the player remains within their melee range (including diagonal spaces) after three ticks, they will have 5 prayer points drained.
They are spectral creatures but not undead , meaning the Ectoplasmator will provide prayer experience for defeating them, but the Salve amulet and its variants will not affect them.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Taloned Wyverns are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 66 in order to be harmed. They reside in the Wyvern Cave on Fossil Island . Like with other Wyverns , an elemental , mind , dragonfire or ancient wyvern shield provides significant protection against their icy breath, and they are vulnerable to the effects of dragonbane weapons . These monsters require completion of the Bone Voyage quest to be assigned as a Slayer task.

In addition to Melee and icy breath, Taloned Wyverns also use a typeless ranged attack that resembles a lighter coloured Water Bolt . This attack ignores Protection prayers and hits for up to 10 damage. Fighting within Melee range is advised as they will be made less likely to use this.

The task-only cave entrance is a trapdoor in the Mushroom Forest and the regular cave entrance is south of the Museum Camp . When a player attempts to attack wyverns in the Slayer task area without a Fossil Island wyvern Slayer task , Weve ( Steve 's son) will stop them from doing so.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Terror dogs are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 40 (not boostable) to kill. Being the personal pets of Tarn Razorlor , [ 1 ] they are first encountered during the miniquest Lair of Tarn Razorlor , in which the player must fight two terror dogs, alongside some animated armour in addition to Tarn himself. Upon completion of the miniquest, more terror dogs can be found in the room.

Terror dogs use an accurate melee attack. As the room they are fought in is a multi-combat area, fighting them can become very dangerous quickly, as multiple terror dogs can attack the player all at once.
Terror dogs do not count toward fulfilling a Slayer task for dogs; they are a separate task. They are the only monsters that drop the Granite helmet .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Tormented Demons are extremely powerful demons bound into a state of perpetual agony, healing their bodies as they burn, summoned by the Mahjarrat Lucien after he teleports away the Stone of Jas during While Guthix Sleeps . They can be found throughout the Ancient Guthixian Temple after completion of the quest.
Tormented demons count as greater demons for the progression of Slayer tasks . As demons, they are susceptible to the effects of demonbane weapons .

They are primarily killed for their tormented synapses , which are used to create high-tier demonbane weapons, as well as their burning claw drop, two of which are combined into the burning claws , a special attack weapon that sits in between the dragon dagger and dragon claws in terms of power, but are more effective against demons (such as tormented demons).

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Tortured gorillas are found in the Crash Site Cavern after completion of Monkey Madness II . Nine tortured gorillas are fought during Monkey Madness II; three level 142 gorillas while riding a stunted demonic gorilla in Glough 's laboratory, four level 142 gorillas in the Tree Gnome Stronghold , and two level 141 gorillas during the penultimate fight of the quest.

Tortured gorillas are nearly identical to demonic gorillas ; they can use all three combat styles and can change them, though they will do so after four missed attacks, not three. Their drop table is considerably worse however, with their unique drops being ten times rarer compared to demonic gorillas.
Unlike their stronger counterparts, tortured gorillas are not considered black demons for a Slayer task, though they do count towards a monkey task.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Troll generals are huge and powerful trolls that live in the Troll Stronghold , on the top floor.

Troll generals can be very advantageous to kill as a higher-level choice when assigned trolls , as they have a reasonably high drop rate of law and nature runes , as well as high alch drops such as steel platebodies , adamant axes , rune warhammers , and granite shields .

Troll generals have somewhat low accuracy on their attacks. However, high-tier melee armour (such as Barrows ) is still recommended if not using prayer, as they can hit extremely hard (up to 38). Their attack speed of 4 (same speed as an Abyssal whip or a scimitar) can also prove deadly if they hit twice or thrice in a row. Therefore, use of the Protect from Melee prayer is strongly recommended if you're not using high-tier melee armour.

Tstanon attacks with Melee and has a maximum hit of 15. Tstanon is usually not considered a threat compared to K'ril, since most players already have Protect from Melee active while fighting the Zamorak bosses.
Tstanon Karlak is considered a greater demon for the purpose of a Slayer task . As with most demons, he is susceptible to the effects of demonbane weapons .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Turoth are Slayer monsters that require a Slayer level of 55 to kill. They are melee based, and as such Protect from Melee will negate all of their damage. They drop herbs and seeds commonly, though not as frequently as aberrant spectres , as well as frequent nature runes . In addition, they also drop the leaf-bladed sword and necklace of fangs .

Turoth, like kurask , can only be damaged with leaf-bladed weapons , broad arrows and bolts , or the Magic dart spell due to their thick hides. [ 1 ] Turoth are immune to other types of attacks, thereby establishing hidden skill requirements to kill them (particularly for ironmen ). Though most of the means available for attacking them cannot inflict poison, it is still possible to inflict venom by using either a serpentine helm or a toxic staff of the dead with Magic Dart . This also means the dwarf multicannon is ineffective, and cannot be placed in this area.

Although turoth are invulnerable to any damage from the eldritch Nightmare staff , Saradomin godsword , and toxic blowpipe special attacks, they will still heal the player as if it would have dealt damage, making them useful as special attack weapons during extended trips. The ancient mace special attack also restores Prayer points equal to the damage that would have been dealt. Guthan's equipment's set effect does not work.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Twisted Banshees are stronger variants of banshees that require level 15 Slayer to kill. They are found exclusively within the Catacombs of Kourend , in a multicombat area . There is a safespot in the walkway between the two rooms. Players must wear earmuffs or a Slayer helmet while fighting them in order to avoid the effects of their screams, which cause the player to take 7 damage and have their stats greatly reduced in Attack , Strength , Defence , Ranged , Magic , Prayer , and Agility with every attack received. They use magical melee , and their attacks are fairly accurate. These opponents seem to regenerate 1 hp each time they are attacked, regardless of whether or not your hit deals damage. As a result, Thralls, especially the lesser variants, are not very effective when fighting Twisted banshees.
As they are undead, the Crumble Undead spell and the Salve amulet do work on them.
They are popular with Ironmen players due to good experience rates for their level along with dropping generous amounts of herbs, pure essence and various rune equipment.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The TzHaar-Ket are TzHaar who serve as the guards of Mor Ul Rek . [ 1 ] They attack with melee .
A TzHaar-Ket can become aggressive when any nearby TzHaar-Hur or TzHaar-Mej is attacked up to six tiles away from the TzHaar-Ket.

All TzHaar have an uncommon chance to drop uncut sapphires , uncut emeralds , and uncut rubies as well as a rare chance to drop uncut diamonds . The drop rates listed below for materials ( gems and Onyx bolt tips ) increase by 33% when wearing a charged ring of wealth .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The TzHaar-Mej are TzHaar mystics who guide their fellow TzHaar. [ 1 ] They fight with both melee and magic using their staves .

When attacked within six tiles of other higher level TzHaar ( Ket and Xil ), the mage will cry out: Kot kl, zek e JalYt! , which roughly translates to "Save me, attack the human!" This will cause the nearby TzHaar to aid the TzHaar-Mej in combat. A TzHaar-Mej can become aggressive when any nearby TzHaar-Hur is attacked up to six tiles away from the TzHaar-Mej.
The drop rates for gems increase by 33% when wearing a charged ring of wealth .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: The TzHaar-Xil are the agile hunters of the TzHaar , hunting the volcanic creatures for food. [ 1 ] They are also responsible for creating the TzHaar Fight Cave and TzHaar Fight Pit , which they use for practice [ 2 ] and sport respectively. [ 3 ]

They can be found wielding three Toktz-xil-ak , a set of Toktz-xil-ul (which they use in both melee or ranged style), or a Toktz-xil-ek . The meleers can conveniently be ranged or maged from safespots around the various sulphur vents and fissures in the cave. A TzHaar-Xil can become aggressive when any nearby TzHaar-Hur or TzHaar-Mej is attacked up to six tiles away from the TzHaar-Xil.

The TzHaar-Xil that is slightly taller and wielding the Toktz-xil-ul will stop attacking for one turn when switching from ranged to melee attack styles, and will not switch back to ranged. Players using protection prayers should bear this in mind when fighting them. Fighting the TzHaar-Xil which wields a set of Toktz-xil-ul is not recommended, as their ranged attack hits higher (up to 16) and more often than its melee attack.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Umbra is one of the four mages guarding Nex in the Ancient Prison , within in the God Wars Dungeon . Having mastered shadow magic , she enhances Nex's powers over shadow. As with all of Nex's mages, she is immobile.
Umbra is invulnerable to damage until Nex reaches below 60% of her hitpoints. This is indicated by her shouting, Umbra, don't fail me!
She attacks using Shadow Barrage and can lower players' Attack levels by 15%.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Undead Druids are followers of Ranul , the god of the moon, who have become corrupted and undead . They can be found in various sections of the Forthos Dungeon : the Crypt of the Moon east of the western dungeon entrance, the Temple Library (which has a nearby altar where players can recharge prayer ) and the small chamber south of the Spider Den near Brother Aimeri , which requires a knife or slash weapon to access.
While not in melee range, they will only attack with their magic attack. Players can avoid damage entirely by praying against magic attacks.
As undead druids are undead, a Salve amulet(ei) (or simply the regular enchanted version if using melee ) is highly recommended for fighting them.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Vampyre kraken are powerful sea krakens that are exclusively found in the Northern Ocean . This essentially gives them a requirement of 78 Sailing for the Eternal brazier , which in turn has an unboostable 76 Sailing requirement to acquire the eternal brazier schematic . They do not count towards Cave Kraken or Vampyre slayer tasks.
The player may be assigned to kill them as a bounty task starting at 80 Sailing . A guaranteed bounty task for them can always be found at Lunar Isle .

Players with two active vampyre kraken bounty tasks will only receive vampyre kraken tentacles until the task is completed at which point vampyre kraken ink sacs will begin to drop. Players do not need to return to a port and turn in their first task to begin receiving the drop for the ink sac task.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Veiled krakens are powerful sea krakens that are exclusively found throughout the Southern Expanse , requiring an adamant helm to reach. Starting at level 80 Sailing , they may be assigned as bounty tasks at Port Tyras and Deepfin Point . A guaranteed bounty task can be received from Deepfin Point. Veiled krakens can drop inky paint like other kraken. Their unique drop is the dragon cannon barrel ; although shared with opulent salvage , they have a considerably more common drop rate for it.

Unlike other sailing krakens, veiled krakens attack with melee. They are highly defensive in a manner similar to armoured krakens ; although the defences are inversed (having more magic defence compared to ranged), veiled krakens also have 15 flat armour , meaning any melee or ranged hits that deal 15 or less damage will simply not hurt it at all. They are weakest to heavy ranged attacks, although the high flat armour means players should man a cannon to deal considerable damage to them. Alternatively, in spite of their high magic defence, magic can also be used with confliction gauntlets , as their high magic defence means that its passive will activate frequently for increased accuracy; magic attacks also ignore flat armour.

A safespot exists for veiled krakens as shown by the picture below. This allows players to kill veiled krakens without ever being attacked, although this will only attract the spawn south-west of the safespot as the others will be too far. Entering the safespot from the south will aggro a nearby great white shark , but it can't attack into the safespot; entering from the north will rarely aggro the krakens, but if they do then they can attack into the safespot. An estimated 83 kills per hour can be achieved unassisted at 99 ranged with a dragon cannon, dragon cannonballs, elite void armour, and divine ranging potions, losing approximately 195 cannonballs if the ballistic attractor is built. The safespot will allow players to loot the kraken's corpse without having to move out of the spot.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Vyrewatch Sentinels are stronger variants of the Vyrewatch , and can be fought after completing the Sins of the Father quest. They can be found prowling the streets of the upper class areas of Darkmeyer , in search of unruly humans to snack on. The Vyrewatch Sentinels are one of the only monsters that drop the blood shard (the other being venators ), although they can also be obtained via pickpocketing the various Vyre citizens throughout the city.

As with all members of the Vyrewatch, they can only be harmed with the Sunspear, Hallowed flail , Blisterwood sickle , Ivandis flail , Blisterwood flail , or Blisterwood stakes . Despite being invulnerable to any damage from weapons like the Saradomin godsword and ancient mace , special attacks will still heal & restore prayer points as if they had dealt damage. The burning claws and Arkan blade special attacks can also apply burn in a similar fashion.
The ability to be assigned vampyres can be purchased for 80 Slayer reward points . Once unlocked, they can be disabled, but players must spend another 80 points to unlock them again.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: A wall beast is a Slayer monster that requires level 35 Slayer to kill. A spiny helmet or Slayer helmet is required to start fighting one; without these helmets, a player will be grabbed and hurt without a chance to retaliate. When their initial grab is repelled with either helmet, the message Your helmet repels the wall beast! will be displayed. Players will not be assigned these as a task until they reach level 5 Defence , as it is required to wear the spiny helmet. This monster is not very popular, due to the fact that its drops are poor with the exception of the mystic hat (light) . It is found only in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves . A light source is required, as is a rope if the caves have not been visited before.

This creature is infamous for surprising (and sometimes killing) low-level players who are traversing through the Lumbridge Swamp Caves. Wall beasts can be avoided when running by starting from a tile adjacent to the hole, thus skipping over the tile in front of the hole. Wall beasts can be a good source of guam leaf as it is the only herb they drop.
The spiny helmet is only required to initiate combat with a wall beast. Once it has started attacking normally, it can no longer grab the player's head, allowing a black mask to be used.
Wallasalkis can be found throughout the Waterbirth Island Dungeon and on Grimstone . They attack with powerful Magic and their projectile resembles Water Wave .

Unlike most other monsters in the dungeon, wallasalkis are much stronger than their combat level suggests; their attack, while somewhat inaccurate, can deal up to 30 damage, and they are highly resistant to both melee and magic attacks. Players killing them should use ranged.
When their health falls low, wallasalkis may attempt to retreat, much like giant rock crabs .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Warped jellies are stronger variants of jellies that require level 52 Slayer to kill. They are found exclusively within the Catacombs of Kourend , both southern and eastern. Warped jellies count towards a Jellies Slayer task , but they do not count towards a Warped creatures Slayer task .

Jellies attack with magical melee , so armour with high magic defence is recommended, such as Karil's armour or black dragonhide armour . Like their lower levelled counterparts, using Protect from Melee will prevent all damage from them. Warped jellies in the eastern chamber can be safespotted using the water in the south-east corner of the chamber. They can either be attacked across the body of water, or around the two corners.

Players looking to kill warped jellies as quickly as possible may do so through the use of AOE attacks like chinchompas and/or Ice Barrage , especially on a Slayer task. Alternatively, ranged gear and a venator bow can be used as a low-effort method for gathering hard clues relatively quickly.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Warped Terrorbirds are creatures found in the Poison Waste Dungeon beneath the Galarpos Mountains , requiring partial completion of The Path of Glouphrie and level 56 Slayer to kill. It is recommended to wear earmuffs or a Slayer helmet while fighting them in order to halve their max hit and reduce chip damage through protection prayer from their ranging attacks. [ 1 ] Players must have the crystal chime in their inventory to fight them, otherwise they will be invulnerable. They do not count for bird Slayer tasks, and it is not required to be on task to kill them.
Warped terrorbirds will never grow tolerant of intruders, and will remain aggressive even after staying in their tolerance region for ten minutes. [ 2 ]

There is a safespot at the beginning of the dungeon, from which the terrorbirds can be attacked with any 9 range or higher weapon, such as a crossbow on longrange, by opening the two doors leading to the first terrorbird room and luring several, then standing 9 tiles away near the warped tortoise. Alternatively, if players stand on the tile south-adjacent to the southern-most point of the poison wastewater, they can remain safespotted from the terrorbirds' melee attacks, and use Protect from Missiles to avoid taking damage. In the latter case, a Dwarven multicannon can be used to assist in luring the terrorbirds.

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Warped Tortoises are creatures found in the Poison Waste Dungeon beneath the Galarpos Mountains , requiring partial completion of The Path of Glouphrie and level 56 Slayer to kill. Players must have the crystal chime in their inventory to fight them, otherwise they will be invulnerable.
Warped Tortoises only attack with melee , meaning players should equip armour with melee defence . Alternatively, players can nullify all damage by praying Protect from Melee .

They can be safespotted in the Poison Waste Dungeon by traversing to one of the rooms further in the dungeon, where there are two tortoises surrounded by four pillars in the centre of the room, as well as pillars along the walls. By standing on the east or west of these four pillars in the centre, the player can attack the tortoises using ranged or mage without being attacked. Using a halberd also will work in the safespot. There is another safespot in the second room with the one Warped Tortoise, if hit from the angle shown in the image below.

They have low defence but a decent amount of hitpoints , making them reasonable training targets, though their drops aren't very desirable.
They have the exact same appearance, stats, and drops as the Fremennik market guards , except they wield warhammers instead of Fremennik blades .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Waterfiends are demonic creatures of water [ 1 ] found in the Ancient Cavern underneath the Baxtorian Falls , as well as in Kraken Cove and Iorwerth Dungeon . They are moderately resistant to all forms of combat with the exception of crush and heavy ranged attacks, against which they are significantly more vulnerable. They use a magic attack whose projectile resembles Water Blast , along with a magical ranged attack resembling ice arrows .

Duradel and Konar quo Maten are the only Slayer masters who assign waterfiends, and they are a rare assignment. To unlock waterfiends as a task, players must have at least level 75 combat (unless they have requested Slayer masters ignore combat level requirements), and have progressed Barbarian training up to being prompted to access to the Ancient Cavern as part of Barbarian Firemaking training. [ 2 ]
Killing a waterfiend may be a required step for an elite clue scroll .

page_context_first_three_paragraphs: Wyrms are draconic creatures requiring level 62 Slayer to kill, found in the lower level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon in Mount Karuulm as well as in the Wyrmscraig Cavern after partial completion of Fallen From Grace . Players can travel to Mount Karuulm quickly by using the fairy ring C I R located south of the mountain. Players can also directly teleport to Mount Karuulm with Rada's blessing 3 or 4. Wyrms located in Wyrmscraig Cavern can be accessed easily using a Slayer ring teleport. When fighting the wyrms located in the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon players must wear the boots of stone , boots of brimstone , or granite boots to protect themselves from the extreme heat of the dungeon floor. Players who have completed the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary do not need to wear this footwear to avoid being rapidly burned.

Wyrms do not require any form of dragonfire protection . When encountered, they will be slithering on the ground. However, once attacked, they will levitate off the ground and attack the player. They can still be hit with melee. Wyrms attack with both Melee and Magic ; however, if attacked from a distance, they will only use their magic attack. This makes the Ranged attack style while using a form of magic protection, such as Protect from Magic , or armour with high magic defence bonuses like dragonhide , a viable method for killing wyrms.

Wyrms are vulnerable to the effects of dragonbane weapons , which include the dragon hunter lance , dragon hunter crossbow , and dragon hunter wand . In the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon , a dwarf multicannon cannot be set up, as the message "The electricity here is too powerful for you to set up a cannon here" will appear; however, it can be used in the Wyrmscraig Cavern . They are also immune to both venom and poison. When leaving their idle stance, they will clear any burn effects.

Zakl'n Gritch is considered a lesser demon for the purpose of a Slayer task , and similarly it can drop the lesser demon champion scroll . As with most demons, he is susceptible to the effects of demonbane weapons .
